You must defend clients accused of various crimes committed using magic and use the rules of magic to prove them innocent. However, the system is corrupt to its core and manipulated by the aristocracy. Will you acquit your innocent clients in light of that? Or will you fall before a corrupt judicial system?

title: Unit Down
description: A fast-paced arcade-styled shooter with permadeath! Arcade game difficulty, randomly generated runs, fantastic voice acting, colorful characters, and a simple yet unique upgrade system!

title: Liftoff: Micro Drones
description: Explore the world of FPV like never before! In Liftoff: Micro Drones any indoor area becomes an exciting aerial playground. Explore, customize and compete in this simulator dedicated to the micro drones class.

title: Handy Dice
description: Handy Dice allows you to roll many kind of dice. They can be customized by you or even created by other users thanks to Steam Workshop. Also features many functions in order to fit to your needs.

title: Broken Veil
description: Broken Veil is a puzzle platformer with horror elements. Experience a post-soviet provincial Russian town through the eyes of a young boy and help him search through the faceless crowd for the most important person in a child's life – his mother.

title: ReversEstory
description: 2D roguelike action shooter. Utilizing the action of flying around freely 360 degrees, we will capture the randomly generated ruins. Strengthening systems and stages that differ greatly depending on the character, and boss enemies ... There are also characters from the Metroidvania-like system.

title: Lashek
description: Make up your mind to enter the Lashek family home and solve its mystery!

title: The Great Plague Exodus
description: The Year is 1665 and the Great Plague has struck London. Guide your family through the darkest period of English history as you flee across the country. Navigate 100s of random events that challenge your ethics and your drive to survive.

title: Disco Ball
description: Control a glowing ball and perform dexterous maneuvers on moving platforms

title: Last Man
description: Become the Last Man on his quest to retrieve the Jade Monkey for Master. Just shoot everything that moves while sidescrolling to the right with up to 3 friends! Face endless waves of enemies that can traverse the map more or less like you do.

title: Nevermore: The Chamber Door
description: NEVERMORE: The Chamber Door is an indie game developed by just one person, with fluid combat in the style of hack n 'slash and lore inspired by the work of Edgar Allan Poe.

title: Frontiers Reach
description: Jump into a starfighter in service of the privateer fleet of the frontier worlds and take on the encroaching authoritarian regime of the Sol Confederacy Consolidate Navy as they attempt to bring war to the frontier worlds.

title: The Inheritance of Crimson Manor
description: Explore a beautiful and Enigmatic Victorian Manor with a dark secret, In this narrative horror first person exploration puzzle game filled with fine art, secret passages and mysterious mechanical puzzles playing as the executor of the last will from the enigmatic Railroad Magnate Hadley Strangre.

title: Rotate to Find the Difference
description: Have you ever seen "Find the difference" that does not split the screen and needs to be rotated to play? That's it for this game. It tests your memory and may also help you exercise it. The game has 10 themed worlds, and different objects are generated programmatically, so you can play forever.

title: Cyberpunk Madness
description: Cyberpunk Madness - is a 3D hardcore shooter with surviving elements in which there is a story of one man suffering from psychiatric disorder.

title: Racing Outlaws
description: Best Drag n Drift Car Racing Games Quench your thirst for unruly racing , release your stress while you dash destroy and crash the objects on the road as you race along the most realistic racing tracks with most furious competitors.

title: Cardboard Invasion
description: Cardboard Invasion is a FPS Tower Defense game set in the world of imagination. Set out on an adventure on your own or with friends to defend Cardboard Land from invading forces by constructing defensive towers, calling in reinforcements, equipping special weapons and more...

title: Chess Knights: High Noon
description: In Chess Knights: High Noon you are one of the deadliest gunslinger of the Old West. Use your instincts and fast trigger skills to hunt and kill all the Wanted Ones. Do it for fame or simply for a fistful of dollars.

title: Wind Wind
description: Wind Wind is a puzzle adventure game. Lead the souls to the top floor of the tower, avoiding robots and the black star which are in the way

title: Barely Racing
description: Barely Racing is an isometric view racing game, inspired strongly by Death Rally and other old-school racing games. However, we spiced it up a bit with online play and weapon choice.

title: Dragon Little Fighters 2
description: Dragon little fighters will always be a fantasy fight game. Play with Strategy and command your team as well just like the first game. This is a Anime style fantasy game. We will be updating this game for very long time.

title: JumpCubox
description: JumpCubox is a physics-based 2.5D platformer. Roll and jump your cube through harsh traps in order to reach the goal.

title: Underland
description: Use the elements at your disposal, such as excavators, pumps, plumbing, among others, to drill the soil to the indicated location. The dynamic scenario, fluid mechanics and the laws of physics must be manipulated correctly to achieve the goal. Find the city of Underland!

title: Super Chicos
description: Juego en tercera persona para niños y padres. Es un pequeño mundo abierto donde los niños pueden aprender a emprender en pequeños negocios como la venta de limonadas, pasteles y también aprender sobre finanzas, con entretenidas misiones e importantes moralejas para la vida.

title: Nurose
description: Build your own custom spells in Nurose. Challenge others to online duels where you will fight using your own custom made spells. You can create shields, mines, clones, movement abilities, and much more.

title: Cave Crawl
description: Cave crawl is an action-packed first-person melee adventure where you navigate your way through chambers of enemies to hopefully climb out alive. On the way you may find mysterious merchants who sell strange and curious items to aid you on your journey.

title: A Million Conquests
description: Experience the thrill of a shmup game like the arcade classics. With just the right amount of story, lots of action, and many, many bullets.

title: Savage Steel
description: 4 player local co-op barbarian themed hack & slash adventure! Get a feel for your playstyle; from the brutal barbarian, the agile elven archer, the acrobatic tribal warrior, or the devious rogue. Then set off together with friends (or alone!) and slay the undead and demon army of the evil overlord!

title: Relics of the Lost Age
description: The Nazis are scouring the globe for powerful occult artifacts. Can you beat them to the treasures and save the world from a thousand years of darkness?

title: Lunar Rover
description: Explore the surface of the Moon aboard the Lunar Rover and discover famous landing sites. From the Apollo space program to the Soviet Luna missions, there are plenty of sites to explore. Experience driving in lower gravity on a unique open world map.

title: Shards of Feyra
description: This is a turn based tactical RPG, which could be played with your friend or solo. Each player will control 2 heroes and try to help the village leader with various quests and save the land of Feyra.

title: Humanless
description: Play as a super skilled combatant, with superhuman speed and agility. Fight against merciless demons, while dashing and jumping to dodge evil traps through carefully designed levels.

title: Karting
description: Climb aboard your kart and beat records alone or with friends in a unique arcade game!

title: Super Can Cannon
description: Super Can Cannon is a 2D challenging timing action game with some puzzle elements and features a total of 60 levels across 5 different stages + 1 extra stage.

title: Winter War 1939
description: Epic World War 2 battles. Finland vs the Soviet Union.

title: Model City
description: Welcome to Model City, a calm relaxing small game where your objective is to maximise the value of your city.

title: Junk Architect
description: This is the story of Junk Architect. You need to complete building tasks using unconventional building materials. On each level you will need to manage your materials that are level-specific, and finish goals using your skill and creativity.

title: Nano Fighter Anti Disease
description: Nano Fighter Anti Disease is a flight action game. Controlling a nanoscale fighter, flies over the acid sea of digestive system, passes through the scarred inflammatory lesions, launch a fierce attack towards various pathogens with medicine ammos and biological missiles.

title: Don't Fall Asleep
description: A short, mini-shooter inspired by all-nighters and meant to be played in quick runs. Rapid gear progression and powerful consumable items are matched by swarms of ever-increasing enemies. No extra lives--falling asleep is game over.

title: Waronoi
description: Imagine a chess board where you can zoom in to see that every piece, is made up by several smaller pieces, which is made up by several smaller pieces, etc. Waronoi is a modern military real-time strategy game on a breath taking scale, where the fate of an entire army can be altered by a single unit.

title: Gangster War
description: Help cool John avenge the betrayal, destroy the enemies and regain power over the city! Shoot the gangsters, shoot the gangsters, throw grenades into the crowd and drop bombs!

title: Vermitron
description: They're Coming! Get ready to defend your lovely Flower from invading insect! Prepare your Bug Spray, Call your Holo-Pet, Fortify base and don't forget your mission: Find the Watering-Can!

title: Turbo Sloths
description: Become the new star of the Wasteland League. Your task is to bring a multi ton clumsy car to frantically speeds with powerful turbine. Pimp your Turbojunk, set powerful boosters, stock up on active gas and go ahead - show what speed is.

title: Supa Birdie Boi
description: Supa Birdie Boi - a simple, yet somewhat layered platformer game, packed with many short, action-packed levels. Pixel-art graphics and an old LCD-green shade both give off that nostalgic 90's feel, when much of gaming world was enclosed in a classic Game Boy.

title: Parkour Bot
description: Parkour Bot is a fast paced, rhythm based, physics platform game, with an unique movement set of main character. Show your skills and get a lot of achievements in 100 dynamic levels.

title: Creas
description: Creas is a contemporary/fantasy RPG that tells the story of a young man discovering the existence of creatures from his imagination. He now finds himself in a conflict that threatens the fate of humanity and he is the only hope for his survival…

title: Deserted
description: Deserted is a stylized 3D action adventure with light RPG and narrative elements. Inspired by the alien atmosphere of Out Of This World, Deserted combines narrative storytelling with survival and fast paced strategic combat to deliver a thrilling adventure.

title: Silicon Valley Investor
description: Silicon Valley Investor is a business simulation game. You will play as an investor who came to Silicon Valley alone. Through your unique perspective, you will improve your worth, experience different stories. you can choose your lifestyle at will, how will you spend your investment career?

title: Line Dots
description: Line Dots it's minimalist and challenging puzzle where the colored dots must be connected by a line without crossing them.

title: JungleKnight
description: This is a casual puzzle game, there will be small monsters on the road, the knight in order to get food need to avoid these monsters in order to get food forward!

title: Red Frozen
description: Red Frozen is a game that embodies all the stereotypes about Russia and even a little more. Here you can ask your neighbor for a Kalashnikov assault rifle, tame a bear and play the balalaika!

title: Just Read the Instructions
description: A surreal co-op first person shooter game where the only thing that matters is following the next set of instructions. Enemies will flood the scene, your weapons will break, more instructions will come, and then repeat. Aspire to not die.

title: Rabbit Riot
description: The dark story about a scientist who tried to transplant a man into a rabbit

title: Home: A Quarantine Story
description: A narrative adventure game about being trapped at home during the COVID-19 pandemic. For fans of To the Moon, Gone Home, and Night in the Woods.

title: GyroBlade
description: A retro 2D vertical scroll shooter.

title: Stellar Raid
description: Stellar Raid is a side-scrolling run and gun game inspired by the greatest classic games of the genre! With a variety of weapon upgrades at your disposal (including a support drone) you’ll charge through hordes of enemy mercenaries to take down one of the Universe’s most notorious space terrorists!

title: Chandrayaan VR
description: A real-time experience of Mission Chandrayaan and an explorative journey through space and time unfolding the story and milestones of the mission.

title: Smoots Golf
description: Hit the green with your friends at over 40 holes!

title: Space Wave Race
description: Only the true heroes of space can become champions of Space Wave Race: the intergalactic championship that will take you to challenge the best pilots in the galaxy!

title: Coeus Plan
description: Immerse yourself in an epic space battle with alien enemies.

title: Perseverance
description: Perseverance is a puzzle game. Solve the levels by sliding the cubes along the way for the Austronaut cat to pass in search of life on the red planet.

title: Javols VR
description: Discover in Lozère, Javols, the capital of ancient Gévaudan completely reconstituted in Virtual reality

title: Wild Times
description: Wild Times - Top Down Shooter, where the player dodging all kinds of dangers, fires back and performs various tasks, finding and improving his weapons throughout the game, getting bonuses and moving from one world to another.

title: Astonia Resurgence
description: Astonia Resurgence is an isometric 2.5D MMORPG set in a Medieval world with swords and magic. Be a Warrior, specializing in melee combat, or a Mage, specializing in casting spells. If you are able to beat the Gatekeeper himself, you may become a Seyan'Du, gaining all abilities of Warriors and Mages.

title: Dungeonman
description: Deck out your dungeon! Play the original deck battler/dungeon builder hybrid. Create your own dungeons with a unique set of story-telling tools and battle through other players' campaigns online. Embark on a single-player or co-op quest; follow three heroes pursuing the destructive Dungeonman.

title: The Frog Prince
description: The Frog Prince is a 3D physics-based multiplayer platformer where players climb challenging environments, use their tongues to interact with other players, and work together or compete to reach the top.

title: Tsukisas Arena
description: The simplest and deepest competitive action game set in a water tank. There is an only one law, "Stab with pointy head" !!

title: Starfighter Renegade
description: Fly into battle across multiple bite-size levels of exciting 3D aerial combat! Do you focus on taking out the alien fighters? Or rescue the stranded inhabitants before they're abducted? What about the deadly terraforming virus sweeping the surface below?

title: The Island of Spirits
description: The Island of Spirits is a randomly generated action 2D Platformer Rogue-Like. Following the Green Knight on his adventure to get the bounty of the king. On his way he will fight Mushrooms, Crystals, bizarre creatures and defeat big bosses, discover more about the Green Knight and about The Island.

title: Polity
description: Polity is a casual cross-platform MMORPG set in a dynamic, player-driven world. Players have the opportunity to govern colonies, join other colonies, explore the world, uncover the lore or master diverse skills such as farming, forestry, fishing etc. With a wide variety of features such as quests, achievements, puzzles, mini-games, and crafting, along with extensive customization options, Polity encourages players to forge their own path and create their own unique journey within its expansive virtual realm.

title: Angkor: Runefall
description: Save an magical village in this extraordinary Match-3 game! Use the ancient runes to cast magic and defeat the dark powers.

title: Tower of Wishes
description: Tower Of Wishes is a family friendly, fun Match 3. The game also includes mini games such as Hidden Object, Find Differences, Chain Solitaire and Sliders for that bit of extra fun!

title: Federation77
description: Federation77 - a dynamic VR arena shooter filled with violence, brutality and stimulants. Shoot, chop and dismember a marginalized society in VR. Post-Soviet cyberpunk and reactive rhythmic gameplay.

title: Kamu's Offering
description: Kamu's Offering is a challenging sidescroller platformer with the uniqueness of controlling two entities, the priest that can jump, move, throw and catch, and Kamu's essence that's thrown by the priest and bounces throght the scenery. You have to combine the two to platform your way through Africa!

title: Retroninjacyberassassin
description: This shareware floppy classic transports you to an alternate early 1990s, where the first person genre began not as a 3D adaptation of the side scrolling and top down shooters that came before, but rather as an adaptation of the 80s beat 'em up/hack n' slash classics.

title: Sand to Surf
description: Gain and maintain speed as you surf the treacherous sands of an ancient desert to rescue your world in this blend of the extreme sport and adventure gameplay genres.

title: Lakeside
description: A single, large, mostly outdoor Egyptian themed map, with custom music and textures.

title: Times Infinity
description:
Times Infinity is a surreal story-focused adventure game about doing tasks before a deadline to prevent your death in an offbeat university with even more offbeat dorm mates.

In addition to light adventure game mechanics, it contains light platforming and shooting elements.

The initial scenario is as follows, you are PARA, an up and coming freshman at the Tiffson Institute, all seems to be going well as you move in until you get an odd task from a mysterious creature. Asking you to take all of your dorm mates out for a meal, failing this challenge will lead to your demise. With no other choices in tow you push forward to complete this challenge... Then it all gets odder from there.

In addition to the above, the player will also be able to unlock outfits for the player to wear.

title: Exorcised
description: Become an Exorcist! Defend your city from evil demons by using cute towers designed as shrine maidens. Fight hordes of demons using powerful Alliances and strategize your way towards victory. Upgrade your defense after each map until you'll be able to face the root of all evil!

title: True Hate
description: Die again and again, to start all over again, the taste of victory is sweeter if the path to it is through pain and suffering...

title: WaveTiles
description: A two-player co-op puzzle platformer. Use colored energy Waves to activate the corresponding Tiles in order to create paths that lead to the end of each level. You are challenged to communicate constantly and advance together while facing danger and hidden traps with the help of magical abilities!

title: Space Station Cargo Simulator
description: SSCS is an indie arcade game with puzzle elements, where you take the role of a simple cargo sorter in a huge corporation. You will have to sort the cargo by weight, fragility and content.

title: Rome Reborn: The Colosseum District
description: Go back in time to visit the Colosseum and nearby sites, including the arches of Constantine and Titus, the Meta Sudans, the Temple of Venus & Rome, the Ludus Magnus, and the Colossus of the Sun. Listen to experts and see panoramas of the sites as they appeared in antiquity and as they look today.

title: F.U.B.A.R
description: The World Is Pure F.U.B.A.R. Come together and fight with your friends against never ending waves of the undead.. or go solo and take on the treacherous horde alone.

title: Archangel: Nemesis
description: Follow the story of 13 year old Twigs as she prepares to go to Boarding School!

title: Martial Arts Brutality Premium
description: In this turn based tactical card fighter, you will learn the secrets of Kung Fu, master control of your formidable Chi Energy and perfect the legendary Dim Mak death touch.

title: Fantasy Dungeon
description: Crawl your way through 20 fantasy dungeons. Create and fully customize your hero as a fighter, mage or archer. Fight your way through dungeon after dungeon against over 50 enemies in 12 different themes.

title: Key Escape
description: Key Escape is a precision platformer, where your goal is to pick the padlock and return to the door to get to the next level.

title: Hoovernauts
description: Hoovernauts is a space-themed, 2D action-platformer that supports local multiplayer of up to 4 players. Using game remotes, players can work together to take down hostile space creatures in the campaign mode or fight against each other in the arena mode.

title: Election 2020: Battle for the Throne
description: Fight in the most anticipated battle of the 21st century!

title: Shindig
description: Shindig is a short point-and-click adventure that celebrates the low-key heroism of helping. Explore a cosy hand-drawn world, solve the boggles of your animal friends, and bring the whole community together for a joyous party!

title: Spacebus
description: Spacebus is a single player scifi rogue-lite that allows you to take control of an overworked mechanic on one of the galaxy's oldest and least-maintained means of transportation: the Spacebus. Keep the engines running and help deliver passengers safely to their destination!

title: Slick Racing Game
description: Equip your car and engage in battle, show everyone that you're the best player in the field. Cooperate with other players, create your own clan and fight for new territories. Go to the races and bring items. You can use them to upgrade your weapons or to create the better ones.

title: Sushi Slammers
description: Cute single player arcade experience ! Select, aim and drag to 'slam' into your opponents, clear your arena before time runs out ! Watch out for bombs and portals ! Flicking fun for all the family !

title: KindFolx
description: KindFolx is a fast-paced deckbuilding roguelike where real-time action meets tactical card combat. Play as one of three monsterfolk heroes and battle through randomized encounters, evolving your deck and strategy to take down a ruthless tyrant.

title: Vectro Blast
description: Jump into endless fights in this arcade game. You have just one job: Survive as long as you can and beat your score over and over. The enemies are stronger with each wave so your journey to great score would not be easy.

title: Little Packaging Crew
description: Little Packaging Crew is a casual strategy controller-supported game. Join fellow packaging workers to deliver the max number of packages before the end of each work day. Protect your crew workstations against thieves and giants. Provide food and drinks to keep your crew productive and happy.

title: Thread Fred
description: Thread Fred-Side-Scroller Shooter, under your control is a flying man, you Dodge obstacles from above and below, maneuver between lightning strikes, destroy tangles of threads of evil vegetables and collect bonuses in the form of bread crusts.

title: Remalmok
description: Remalmok- is a first person horror game.

title: Tyrannis
description: Tyrannis is an asymmetric, turn-based strategy game that pits overstretched armies of mercenaries against small rebel groups across an American dystopia.

title: Tavern of Gods
description: "Tavern of Gods" is a roguelite auto battle game. Players collect heroes, skills, followers, and equipment to form various builds to fight with random monsters. Every expedition can get new items, and then you can experience more different builds next time.

title: Tezz
description: Tezz is a block-fit puzzle.

title: Haters
description: Dive into the stylized world of HATERS to release hate into other players with third-person shooter combat. Unlock hate weapons get back those players that buy skins. Enjoy 4 different modes alone or with friends. Download for free today and build your hate.

title: Bellatia
description: Bellatia is a hack 'n' slash action role-playing game about warriors fighting over the ultimate godly weapon called the 'Bellatia' in the land of Aslan.

title: Exoblast
description: Exoblast is a shoot'em up arcade game, pimped with synthwave music and pixel art. Choose your pilot, your ship and join the arena to confront other players in nervous and punitive matches. Impose your gameplay and reach the top of the tower!

title: Undergrowth: VR Maze
description: In this VR simulator, you can explore the sandbox with your Steam Index, HTC Vive, or Oculus Headsets and interact with certain parts of the environment. Jump and just be inside the simulator. Relax and enjoy yourself in the green environment.

title: The Doomed Knight
description: This metrodvania inspired game lets you discover an fascinating world full of monsters, secrets and mysteries.

title: Ordeal
description: Ordeal is a third-person shooter with a WWII setting and a Low Poly style.

title: Ruin Hunters
description: Take command of your heroes in this turn-based tactical game. Wander into the deep of the dungeons, defeat enemies, gather treasures, while your party grows in power.

title: The Adventures of Maximus
description: With the events that lead to the death of Maximus's wife, you embark on an adventure to avenge her death. Fight your way to uncover the mastermind who is responsible for the death of Maximu's wife.

title: Light For Plants
description: Light for Plants is a physics-based puzzle game in which you must direct and manipulate a light beam to reach the plants and save them from the endless darkness.

title: Retrowave Road
description: Welcome back to the 80s! Retrowave Road is an action-arcade game about dodging obstacles at full speed and collecting various pickups. Pixels, synthwave, palm trees and an endless highway...

title: Spider-Man 2: The Game
description:
"Spider-Man 2" for PC and Mac is an almost completely different game than its console counterpart. This is not a port from the console version, but a different version developed by The Fizz Factor and published by Activision.

As Spider-Man you must battle out through 8 chapters of mischief and mayhem to succeed. Along the way you will encounter and have to battle old foes like Rhino, Mysterio, Puma, Doc Ock and more. The game interface consists of a simple point and click system coupled with keyboard movement. Unlike it's console counterpart there is no free swinging movement but one designed with kids in mind.

Fighting consists of basic punching, kicking, jumpkicks and a power meter that let's you do a supercharged attack. 'Spidey' can also zip to walls and objects and use his web to do basic attacks on enemies.

title: Pandemic Violence
description: Beat down citizens taken their gold, kill your neighbors for a roll of toilet paper, and plenty more scenarios like that.

title: Doog
description: This game emulates the classic Doom experience (to an extent) with a Hololive theme.

title: Swordswallower
description: Swordswallower is a psych-goth action platformer where players traverse and fight only by throwing their massive enchanted sword. The player can’t jump, instead launching their sword into the environment and pulling themselves toward it with tremendous force.

title: Alley Catz Bowling
description: Alley Catz Bowling Was created in 2021 to provide fun to twitch users we are a very simply bowling game that can be controlled by twitch by typing !bowl in chat. Users are able to put a spin on there balls and power to there balls and lot more.

title: Influxis
description: A sci-fi underwater survival and exploration game

title: Ready Aim Fire
description: What if you are on an elephant toy battling around in your child-hood toy room? Operate your favorite toy tank mechanically but easily to explore through the cartoon-styled world. Search for the targets, and Ready, Aim, Fire!

title: No Parachute
description: No Parachute is a fast-paced arcade game with a pixel art style, in which you will dodge various obstacles in free fall. Try to find out what is on the other side of the tunnel, and save your arms and legs along the way!

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: Charybdis Outpost
description: In this exclusive mission, unravel the secrets of the Charybdis holding centre as you make your way through unique environments and experience brutal combat against an unknown enemy.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: Desperate Crusade
description: An Imperial ship transporting an Ecclesiarchy relic has crash landed on a world overrun by Chaos. The Caligari Conclave is under grave pressure to assist in the recovery of the priceless artifact. Will you answer the call?

title: Delivery Company Clicker
description: Deliver Company Clicker is a small game with a cozy atmosphere and main goal to unlock every upgrade while listening to a good music

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: Mind Plague
description: Inexplicable violence has broken out amongst Imperial subjects, who began to act like possessed madmen. Is this a Chaos ploy? A Xenos interference? Or perhaps a Warp phenomenon? Either way, this is a matter for the Inquisition.

title: Lux: The Journey
description: Explore a beautiful and mysterious world in Lux: The Journey. Seek lost knowledge, craft, build, survive the dark and find your destiny.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: Grim Penance
description: An Imperial void station has detected a Chaos flotilla on a collision course. Their numbers seem insufficient to pose a real threat but the Inquisition cannot take any chances when it comes to the the followers of Khorne.

title: Dragon Rising
description: Take you to the mysterious world of giant dragons, where you can breed various types of giant dragons.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: Hollow Bliss
description: An Imperial ship with pilgrims on the deck has been quarantined due to a mysterious, Warp-related infection. At first glance this might not concern the Inquisition - however, there are obscure references to this malady in an Ordo case file, but most of the material has been corrupted.

title: Wild Rat
description: Wild Rat - A rhythmic game with a good test of reaction efficiency and speed, dodging flying saws circling the walls and one hated rat, the player must fight off the rat so many times and put a mousetrap that will catch the hated rat.

title: Endless Crawler
description: Endless Crawler is a top down shooter with elements of the Roguelike genre, where the player explores underground levels, destroys hordes of monsters, goes world after world and unlocks improvements that will help him on further adventures.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: City of Suffering
description: Enter the City of Suffering where the Drukhari hunt their human prey on a larger scale. Hinder the Xenos plans, take down as many Pain Catalysts as you can and make them pay for every Imperial citizen they steal.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: Poisoned Souls
description: The spread of Warp-tainted drugs has been reported amongst the populace, with potentially grave consequences for the stability of the affected region. The threat level is still debatable, but the Imperium cannot take risks on matters like this.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: Faith Undone
description: Another wave of seditionist idea has infected an Imperial world. Fortunately, the agents of the Holy Ordos have discovered the trouble before it could spread too far. There is still time to weed out the ringleaders.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: Discordant Choir
description: It has come to our attention that a disturbingly large number of unidentified psykers were found among the denizens of an Imperial world. The Ordo Hereticus has flagged this anomaly as a case of utmost priority.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: Maelstrom of Carnage
description: An unfortunate Imperial world has been overrun by Chaos Daemons. Exterminatus is not yet possible, so selfless sacrifice is needed to keep the tide from spiraling out of control. Are you willing to descend amidst the Daemonic hordes and call orbital strikes while you are fighting down there - for the sake of the Imperium of Man?

title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr: Forgotten Arsenal
description: An ancient, forgotten Imperial Vault has been rediscovered. Does it contain any valuable artifacts? Important writings? Perhaps codices of vile heresy? It is your job to find out and secure whatever treasure or evil lies within.

title: Mollycoddle Mayhem
description: Mollycoddle Mayhem is a couch co-op game for up to four players where you work together to spoil and pamper babies that have been anonymously abandoned. Cook, clean, change diapers, and perform various other tasks before the little ones get too upset.

title: Eia
description: A short story in which a boy saves a girl.

title: Battle Guns Simulator
description: Welcome to Battle Guns Simulator with great gameplay, lots of customizations, weapon options and accessories. Start this game and test your skills!!

title: Redd's Runaway
description: Stop the Underworld's hordes of demons and ghouls in this Arcade game, inspired by the Day of the Dead and Halloween.

title: Zero Wrath Vendetta
description: Dodge enemy beams with your space fighter, kill huge bosses, and sing along to seven distinct songs in this unique rock opera videogame.

title: Soul Challenge
description: After people died, the soul will go to its destination, or will be punished and reborn. In the game, you will play a lost soul in hell and his girlfriend, and you will face a series of challenges. After completed the series of challenges, you will reach the victory of eternal life.

title: I Have Powers!
description: This is a super heroic super hero arcade fighting game, make a Super hero using the classic 4 color costume design of comic-book Heroes. See how powerful you can make your character, see how long they can survive. Choose lots of different Super Powers, stop crime by any means!

title: Box: Boxing
description: Box: Boxing is a multiplayer virtual reality boxing game with action filled gameplay and unique graphics. Fight against the CPU or others players in the craziest scenarios you've ever seen and become the champion of the Box:Boxing world!

title: Mean-While
description: Two rivaling megalomaniacs are forced to work together in hopes to survive each other's fortresses. Join Skeleman, and his rival, Dr. Dangerous, in the thrilling comedic adventure title: Meanwhile.

title: The Spiral Labyrinth
description: Let's take on the challenge of the Spiral Labyrinth, which changes shape every time you enter! In this roguelike game, you use various items to fight the powerful monsters lurking in the labyrinth.

title: Nerm the Worm
description: Nerm the Worm was developed from the heart with the goal of offering a brand new super fun-to-play snake game with unique twists & new turns! Nerm presents challenging goals, an adorable personality, and fifty grueling levels to progress through! Nerm just wants to escape! ..Can you help him?

title: Crashers of Aetheria
description: Crashers of Aetheria is a strategy card collecting game. Players use Crashers to strategically take out their opponent online or offline.

title: Pancake Sailor
description: Relaxing sailing experience. Discover Akalana Islands.

title: Garden Magic
description: A short match 3 game with unique mechanics.

title: Teke-teke
description: Teke-teke is a first-person horror adventure game based on a Japanese myth. The gameplay focuses on storytelling, stealth and decision making, there are also some puzzles for the player to solve, making gameplay more various.

title: Don't Die! Douche!
description: Charge your way through 5 fever-dream induced worlds, dodging a plethora of bizarre dangers on your way. And remember: Don't Die! Douche!

title: The Fellowship Saga
description: The Fellowship Saga is a party-based RPG, immersing you into the action with a first-person view. Using rules from the 5th edition of the world's most popular RPG system, go on an epic adventure as the party becomes entangled in the very survival of the realm.

title: Pole of Cold
description: Pole of Cold is a sci-fi survival horror game set at a research station somewhere in Antarctica. Explore it and find a way to escape death.

title: No More Room in Hell 2
description: No More Room in Hell 2 is a terrifying 8 player co-op action horror experience. Find your friends in the dark and survive - in a dynamic, endlessly replayable zombie apocalypse.

title: Grand Intention Adjustment
description: Back to the roots of a 90's style JRPG! Depending on the player's actions, the shape of the game changes in various ways. This is a full-length RPG with a combination of scenario and freedom. This game is in Japanese only.

title: Orbi's Chronicles
description: Orbi's chronicles is an adventure/RPG game set in a dystopian sci-fi world. The combat takes place on a 16 tiled board with random letter where you must complete words to damage your opponent. The longer the word the better the damage.

title: Vicewave 1984
description: Welcome back to the 80s! A 20-year-old boy named James Bernett is a ghetto boy with ambitions who wants to get everything from the world at once. Very soon, he will create his own criminal empire, built on the sale of drugs and become the most influential drug baron in the city of Los Riveros!

title: HistoryMaker VR
description: Perform as a U.S. historical character in an immersive, virtual reality environment. Create your scene, pick your props, read your script, and export your performance in this VR content creation tool.

title: Hell's Revenge 3D
description: Hell's Revenge 3D is the continuation of "Hell's Revenge" for mobile. It is not necessary to have played the first part to understand this. Denio, Angy, Sr. Demo, Chano and more await you in this adventure.

title: Meow Lab
description: You are an extraordinarily brilliant scientist, but your cat doesn't know that, he just wants some food and care. Move, rotate, connect the blocks correctly and give the kitten some food.

title: August of August
description: An alien spaceship crashes on a frozen planet one day,opening the dramatic story.

title: Deducto
description: A fun hidden role game where you backstab your co-workers and get mad at your co-workers for backstabbing you.

title: The Test: Final Revelation
description: The third chapter in The Test Trilogy. Answer a series of in-depth questions to reveal hidden truths about yourself and unlock secrets to discover who you really are as a person. The Final Revelation is upon us... but are you sure you TRULY want the answers you seek?

title: Rage of Car Force: Car Crashing Games
description: Rage of Car Force is a team multiplayer PvP games 5 vs 5!

title: Big Watermelon
description:
Big watermelon features:
1. Combine the same fruit until it becomes a watermelon, and you can continue to do so.
2. Are you ready? Everyone likes a small game that can quickly complete the task by moving your fingers.

title: Solitaire Forever II
description: 3D solitaire includes Klondike, Eight Off, Miss Milligan, Simple Simon, Eliminator, and more

title: Picross Beach Paradise
description: Get ready for a romantic journey! 120 fun griddlers await you in Picross Beach Paradise!

title: The Thief Girl
description: The Thief Girl is a stealth mission game in which you control a thief girl to collect treasure and get to the goal. Use the mouse to guide the girl to the goal while keeping her hidden from the monsters. Use emergency evasion actions when the monsters are about to find you to conquer the stage.

title: Climb Fall Human Guys
description: Enter each scene, constantly climb to the highest point of the scene, find food to supplement energy, and go to the next scene.

title: TrainClicker Idle Evolution

title: Bǎi Jí Guàiyì yǔ Jīnyú
description: 唯美奇幻的多結局視覺小說。現實與非現實模糊地交替────被遺留或被遺忘的人們的故事。搶先體驗序章故事

title: Boston AInamics
description: The goal of the game it to reach the finish by getting through different obstacles. To do this, teach your robot particular movements - place the icons onto the appropriate place and watch the robot's progress.

title: Legends of Valhalla
description: You are a Norse God, wandering Midgard and harnessing your powers to fight for fame, glory and loot! Legends Of Valhalla is an Multiplayer Open World Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. With a focus on visceral action combat, powerful items and deep character customization!

title: BattleStick 2
description: BattleStick 2 is a humorous free-to-play physics-based 2D stickman Multiplayer Game where you fight other stickmen in an arena with loads of equipment to choose from! It's a direct successor to BattleStick!

title: Univers
description: Survival in space. Explore, repair and build in an ancient spaceship that lost its way many, many years ago...

title: Project: Inferno
description: Run, jump, dash, explore and FIRE in this 16-bit platformer.

title: Lumber Party
description: An online or local multiplayer space monkey racing platformer. Fight your way to the top to grab the banana with tons of different ways to play.

title: Blessings of No-more
description: Blessings of No-more is a 3d rogue-like turn-based RPG. Collect blessings and get stronger with every death to overcome impossible enemies and regain your life.

title: Tales of Herring Lake
description: Welcome to Tales of Herring Lake, where your favourite Sunday fishing show meets Alfred Hitchcock. Grab your gear and start shaping your story!

title: Endless Furry Ping-Pong
description: Welcome to Endless Furry Ping-Pong! The 7th installment of the "Endless Furry" Series! This game is a simple recreation of the classic Pong game, but with a furry twist!

title: Celestial Empire
description: The Emperor has chosen you as a new provincial governor. Design the city of your dreams, admiring its details from a bird's-eye view. Take care of your people, develop efficient production chains and trade with other landlords. Ensure their survival through harsh winters and disasters.

title: Terraformers: First Steps on Mars
description: Terraformers: First Steps on Mars is a free standalone version of Terraformers, featuring an exclusive mission taking place before the main game.

title: Space Explore
description: Space Explore gives you a first hand experience of the journey that astronauts take while embarking on space missions. The space station circles the earth, 400 kilometers above us. It serves as a research laboratory and is also suited for testing spacecraft systems and equipment.

title: Super Head Ball
description: Super Head Ball is an action-packed party game that pits two teams of warriors against each other as they attempt to throw a decapitated head into a blazing pyre. With simple controls and 4-player local multiplayer, matches are fast, frantic, and intense.

title: Valiantia
description: Valiantia is a role-playing game. Solve the puzzles. Altis, a female knight, and you, Leonale as her confidant, were ordered to do missions. You can help her ease the problems, making the decision, or make them more complicated. Her fate depends on you.

title: Soul Dossier
description: Soul Dossier is a multiplayer game based on Oriental culture (5vS1). The game is based on a variety of traditional Oriental cultures, including five elements, eight diagrams and folklore.

title: Blob Lander
description: This is a very interesting game, you need to control the safe landing of the spacecraft to the destination, together to challenge it!

title: Zorro: The Chronicles
description: Zorro: The Chronicles is an exciting and humorous game featuring combat and exploration gameplay inspired by the best action games in class.

title: Human Origin
description: The most important to play this game is to wear a headphone !The built-in videos is not only a game play tutorial, but also an interesting story. which is an hour long .and full of suspense,laughs,pains in it

title: If Fusion Were That Easy
description: "If Fusion Were That Easy" is a humorous 2.5D point-and-click adventure about cold fusion and preventing the apocalypse. Explore a diverse world, master tricky puzzles and stop the inevitable.

title: Atomic Guardians
description: ATOMIC GUARDIANS is a fully CO-OP arcade retro shoot 'em up, where one player flies the ship, and the other player mans the shields. Fight your way through a never ending horde of Brutal Bosses, Alien Monsters and Gigantic Asteroids as you rack up a new world-wide high score. Play with up to three friends, and see how long you can last!

title: Calculate It
description: We've made a calculator roguelike! Yes, it's not a joke. A boring device has turned into an interesting strategy, where each calculator you collect sets its own style of play. Can you count all the numbers and prove who's the king of calculations here?

title: Dallen Clicker Ultimate
description: Dallen Clicker Ultimate is an enhanced remake of Dallen Clicker, an incremental game.

title: Space Pirate King
description: Become a villainous space pirate. Aim for the Pirate King! Customize your space battleship. Attack passenger ships, rob cargo ships, and defeat guards! Japanese indie games

title: Press Ctrl
description: A mind-bending puzzler where your avatar controls another avatar via an in-game keyboard.

title: Ichth.ys
description: Ichth.ys is a visual novel with turn-based combat where your choices affect the story! You follow Fraser, a hacker who was recently expelled from university, in a tale of mystery, deception, censorship, freedom, and board game cafes!

title: Canvas Hockey
description: Canvas Hockey is a top-down, arcade-style party game with local multiplayer tournaments and a single player or co-op campaign. The game uses a painted art-style with inspirations from the 90's.

title: Miko Adventures Puffball
description: Miko is a raccoon who lost his way while wandering through the forest, he discovers a portal and upon touching it he finds himself in a world full of dangers. Miko is transported into another dimension and your goal is to help him find a way back home.

title: Penelope
description: Penelope.wad is a sort of bookend to my first year of mapping, and a distilled extract of everything I like in my mapping soup: complex architecture, out-there texturing, strange progression and a whole lot of atmosphere. There are also a few demons to kill, but nothing worrisome - little more than a nuisance. Only a few are archviles, and even fewer are cyberdemons and spider masterminds. Most combat is optional, and the exit can be reached in only a few minutes, though I'd invite you to stay for the whole experience if you will...

title: After You
description: After You is a narrative game with puzzles, but it is not an easy game, here you will not have indicators or tutorials, nor can you save when you want. In After You you need to put all your attention and use paper and pencil to move forward, if you're looking for an easy game, this is not your game.

title: Village Defender
description: 【Village Defender】is a simple and easy-to-use city defense survival game that combines elements of war, levels, equipment, cards, etc. In addition to the combat targets on each battlefield, you can also challenge yourself to fight against how many waves.

title: Deja-Vu!
description: A small 5-map episode for Quoth. Starts with base maps and ends in a Doom-like "hell bunker".

title: Operation: Vicus
description: Hey, so you're the chosen one? Welcome to your new home, your village! Build it up, develop it, take care of the needs of its inhabitants and fight the evil that haunts your village. But the most important thing is, can you solve the mystery of the village?

title: Stella Voyager
description: Open World Space Exploring Trading Shmup RPG. Space sheriff fighting outlaws. King of inter planet trade. Investor who contribute to the development of the planets. The choice Is yours.

title: Solitaire: Elemental Wizards
description: Classic Solitaire in a fantasy setting! Help Archmage Gideon regain his former glory!

title: Drift Long Racing
description: Enter your favorite car and make a record in this unique arcade game, either alone or with friends!

title: In Search of Fon Vitae
description: "In Search of Fon Vitae" is a mix of roguelike and exploration adventure in a procedural generated pirate themed world.

title: Pitched Battle
description: This game is a war game. It has a top-looking player's eye. Your tank is ready for you. 3D realistic models have tanks, Are you ready for a long war with your friends?

title: Hmmsim Metro
description: Line 1, the most complicated subway in Seoul, is now coming in PC version. You can feel high immersion with the graphics that realize the actual Seoul scenery, the train driving sound, and the realistic train driving system. Experience the operation of the Seoul subway!

title: Santa's Toy Factory Nonograms
description: Get into the spirit of the holiday with 120 exciting nonograms! Stop by and visit Father Christmas!

title: Heptagon
description: HEPTAGON is a fast-paced and fluid action game designed to push your reflexes to their limits.

title: Space Cube Racers
description: Space racing game for up to 4 players (local, split-screen). It uses newtownian mechanics but with an easily to pilot control scheme where your ship will always thrust along your line of sight.

title: Jack 'n' Hat
description: The sinister Dr. Voo Doom has kidnapped the Princess of Ririland and incited a civil war! It's up to repairman extraordinaire, Jack and his boomerang hat to save her and restore peace! Jump through 20+ huge levels, collecting Crystals, Stars and more! Can you save Ririland?

title: Elmarion: Dragon's Princess
description: Elmarion: Dragon’s Princess is an RPG about a Dragon and a Princess. A player plays as a Dragon: flies across a large 3D world, burns whole armies of people, explores interesting locations. Aim of the game: to save the world of Dragons and people together with the Princess.

title: Toy Box
description: A pull-apart puzzle visual novel whose fragments stitch the story together.

title: Catch a Cat for 60 Seconds
description: Casual action game Avoid obstacles by jumping Catch and accelerate cats Compete for a 60-second flight distance on the leaderboard

title: Fugitive Criminal
description: Fugitive Criminal is a stealth maze puzzle with finding keys and doors with a top view. Locations are mazes with doors, some of which are locked and to go further you will have to find the keys that are hidden in the lockers. Complete 20 confusing levels to break free, good luck!

title: You Pilot a Piece of S***: Gaiden
description: You Pilot A Piece Of S***: GAIDEN is an in-depth examination of the turn-key stagnation most inherent in today's post-modern societal constructs...?

title: Mind Mirror
description: Help Omar to go through a puzzle experiment! Logical deductions, and solving problems skills will be required in this sci-fi puzzle environment. Let's combine puzzle, exploration, and escape room elements. You should also play with your friends!

title: Wúmián Yèqǔ
description: Use assault rifle against the magician! Or use the martial arts to smash the machine armor! Purify your blood, upgrade your skills, bring your favorite characters into the world of reincarnation! Players will operate through mouse or keyboard, adventure in a world of different styles!

title: Black Ido
description: Now I can change the gravity, it opens up incredible possibilities. Does this really work in the AVA world? Have we really achieved the impossible?

title: Knight's Maze
description: Four brave knights in search of treasures appeared in an ancient labyrinth. Get them out of there, but don't forget about the traps. Go around them, solve unpretentious puzzles on your way, upon completion of which you will be closer and closer to freedom!

title: Unity Chan and Cube World!!
description: Unity Chan and Cube World!! is a Mario-like 3D platform game, in which rich and difficult traps and monsters are designed. Let's help the kawaii and naughty heroine - Unity Chan to defeat these stages one by one!

title: Mahjong Carnaval
description: Help the countess find unique masks! What hides behind the Mahjong tiles? Find the rarest masks by visiting carnivals around the world!

title: Slime Up
description: Slime Up is an infinite jumper where you jump around the city spraying mucus out of your nostrils and sliming people who get in your way. Rise to the top taking powerful powerups. Just be careful not to fall in the river of slime beneath you...

title: Angel at Dusk
description: Profusely Genuine! Explosively Orthodox! Shoot, dodge, and destroy! A die-hard style, faithful return to the origin of top down shooters!

title: Red Dungeon
description: You control the Outsider and explore multiple levels of a mysterious dungeon with secrets to uncover. As you explore and go deeper into the levels of this dungeon the enemies become more abundant, harder, and stronger. You can only hope you have enough firepower to suppress them.

title: Space Ape
description: How far can you take Dimitri the Russian Space Ape on his arcade adventure!

title: Nosferatu's Butler
description: A surveyor breaks into a mysterious and sinister Mansion on Pleasant Street in order to find his missing sister. She was last seen being interviewed by the mansion's young and mysterious Butler.

title: Decks & Daggers

title: Cosmic Magus
description: A very challenging arcade spellcasting experience.

title: Sloth Tales
description: "It's called Sloth Tales and it's about Jimmy's search for his biological father. Quite frankly it's brilliant." – Wordsworth the Panda.

title: Centrifugal
description: Navigate your rocket through the universe by using the centripetal and centrifugal forces! Wander around the stars and find your way home! Explore what's hidden at the end of the galaxy and have fun with your friends!

title: Petra and the Thylacine
description: Set in Launceston Tasmania's beautiful Cataract Gorge the player will adventure to find grandma's house.

title: Rundom
description: Rundom is a "human" racing game. Sprint, slide, blink, travel through portals and more just to be faster and earn your victory!

title: Rocket Panda Panic
description: It's a Panda-emic! Spreading across the globe causing panic and fear. Only one hero has the courage, power and cuteness to save us all. Join Pandy and his jetpack as they travel the world, protecting us from the critter panda plague.

description: Do you like Sports? Do you really, really like sports? Enough to date one of them? No?... Well.. this is awkward. If you change your mind, oh boy we have the game for you. Become the next big sport, live your best school life, and romance up to seven other sports in this crazy visual novel.

title: Trombone Champ
description: Honk, blow, & toot your way through over 20 songs, collect all 50 unique Tromboner Cards, and uncover the mysteries of the Trombiverse. Do you have what it takes to become the true Trombone Champ?

title: Spooky Speakeasy
description: Make and shake some truly monstrous drinks in this casual bartending simulator!

title: Meteora
description: Be a meteor in a constant race for survival in a young and chaotic universe by dodging, chasing & taking down other meteors in Meteora. Power up, strategize and put your skills to the test in our spectacular arcade combat racer!

title: False Dichotomy
description: Survive to return to your grieving wife. Face your sins. Kill demons. Save lives.

description: A short lore exploration puzzle game inspired by walking simulators such as Gone Home, Dear Esther, and Layers of Fear.

title: Puzzle Guys
description: Puzzle Guys is an adventure puzzle game in which you have to control 4 characters at once.

title: Armored Xpress
description: Armored Xpress is a new unique story-driven Match 3 game built with rich RPG elements and an ATB battle system.

title: Collapse: A Political Simulator
description: Collapse: A Political Simulator is a grand strategy game that takes place in 1992-2004. You take lead of your own Party in the face of the total devastation of one of the fictional post-Soviet states in Europe. Try to realize your (or someone else's) political dreams in the shaky arena of this dilapidated situation.

title: The Last Town: Excape
description: The Last Town Is a first person shooter, tower defense, strategy, survival in one of the independent game.Using equipment to resist the corpses, more than 20 guns, accessories, consumables, mountable defenses were designed for the game, and a real physics engine was used to simulate reality

title: A.V.I
description: Explore the halls of a decrepit mansion and discover it's horrifying secrets from the lens of a missing man's smartphone, revealing his fate and the fate of the family that populated this ominous manor.

title: Corners
description: A logic game for two or four players. The goal is to get all the balls home faster than other players. Play with friends or with a computer opponent.

title: Car Drive
description: Car Drive is a game where you need to get to the finish line by transport.

title: Castle of Collapse
description: Just go up, don't look down, and take down the enemies. You will be addicted to this platform game that will challenge you to the fullest.

title: Clutter 1000
description: The greatest Clutter yet! Clutter 1000 is the most exciting Un-Hidden Object game you will ever play. The object of the game? It's simple: click on two matching objects to remove them from the playfield. Along with your old favorites there are twice as many new variations, for days of fun!

title: Evector: Acid Thirst
description: EVECTOR is a fast-paced arcade FPS shooter with run-and-shoot action, intense battles with short respawn times, and checkpoint based progress (no more save/load cheating). If you're looking for a classic FPS game experience, then try this one!

title: Freed Soft
description: Freed Soft is an it company simulator. You have to build your own IT Empire. Develop your character and your employees. Create the best SOFTWARE in the game world.

title: Space Architect
description: Space station building game. Survive, expand, prosper, and become a major hub!

title: Block'Em!
description: Block'Em! is a multiplayer PvP puzzle-platformer for 2-4 players. Controls are simple but the road to victory is complex: be the first to reach the goal or the last one standing to claim the victory!

title: The Brew Barons
description: A tranquil world becomes ever more corrupt by the day, spoiled by a pirate organization that forcefully impose their brewing monopoly over the lands. It's up to you to explore, forage, craft, sell and deliver your brews to overthrow the corrupt pirate organization and restore peace.

title: The Outbreak Story
description: Join Noah as he follows in his deceased father's footsteps: becoming an agent of the Special Paranormal Defense Forces, a secret organisation that protects people from the paranormal. The organisation has its hands full, however, as a strange disease turns people into monsters.

title: Space Station 14
description: Disasters, enemies, and incompetence conspire to make each shift aboard the station a unique and hellish experience. Sign up today to explore intricate game mechanics and enjoy limitless player interaction! (Nanotrasen Inc. is not responsible for injury, death, or worse).

title: Alien Cat 8
description: A brave cat arrived on a planet and faced an unusual gravity that allowed for climbing vertical walls and jumping over abysses on ceilings. But that’s not that easy in fact.

title: Rogue Card
description: Rogue Card is a roguelike deck builder, where every run is unique and strategy matters. Set in a randomized fantasy world, where tactical decisions affect the outcome of your whole game.

title: Monster Tribe
description: Explore an island filled with collectible creatures, a vast and varied wilderness, and dangerous towers on your way to restoring harmony with the land of Akama.

title: Fish Glutton
description: Indie Underwater Level Arcade Game

description: Follow a young wizard in his path to find the Magical Stones and himself in this Jurassic Fantasy!

description: Risu is a story-driven, survival horror adventure game. Her new home hides a dark secret; Risu Ishikawa must traverse, solve, and survive a hellish architectural-maze of endless personal nightmares, but what lies at the center?

title: Demon Zombie Outpost
description: Demon Zombie Outpost is a 60 + zombie kills 1 level game.

title: Herder
description: Defend your flock of sheep and goats as your traverse colorful procedural alpine meadows in the sky.

title: Where's My Phone?!
description: Where's My Phone?! is a casual, life-simulation game. Run around your house cleaning, getting ready for work, or decorating for your anniversary.

title: Connected Towers
description: Connected Towers is a puzzle game where you play as a robot that needs to connect towers to activate fences, platforms, and much more.

title: Minforiga
description: Minesweeper with a character! Dig down to the center of the earth and mend the core crystal before it's too late.

title: Hauma: A Detective Noir Story

title: Tootinis
description: Tootins is an action packed puzzle adventure game in full 3D filled with original monsters, music and gameplay. Use your bubble spitting powers to smash or push monsters, solve puzzles and save your village. The gameplay is an original mix of action and puzzle elements.

title: Flying Girls
description: "Flying Girls" is a horizontal shooting game with classical Chinese ink painting style.

title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator
description: Service off-road vehicles and take them for a drive! Offroad Mechanic Simulator lets you modify many classic off-road vehicles and prepare them for daunting tasks that no normal car could ever hope to complete. Test your work and climb steep cliffs or drive through rivers and deep layers of mud.

title: Late Stage Inferno
description: Hunt down those responsible for destroying your home. Sneak through ships and kill everyone on board. Climb the ranks until you find reach the top, then take it out. Play out the short story of this alien stuck in a capitalist hell as they take on 8 unique ships.

title: Timmy's Nightmare
description: Timmy's Nightmare is an Action-Rogue-Lite taking place in a nightmarishly dark realm, where it's Timmy versus the Lil Terrors, in an all-out brawl for survival as you hunt for his most priced toy, the stuffed bear. All while being the same size as a Baseball. Will you survive?

title: Wind from City
description: This is an anime visual novel that tells the story of human beings wandering to a survivable planet with 42% oxygen content after the destruction of the earth. Human beings cultivated through genes have developed 2800 years later.

title: The Steps as We Know Them
description: Use the moves of chess to solve puzzles. Find your way with six different pieces, through six different worlds. Use a varying way of thinking in each world.

title: AutoLand
description: You are a little robot moving and jumping through levels searching for the teleport. This is an one-button game with awesome pixel art and an impressive soundtrack.

title: Spirit Clash
description: Blockchain card game on the Enjin platform. Do you have what it takes?

title: The Hilltop Mansion
description: Can you escape from this cursed mansion? Rely on the clues left by the ancestors to break the curse of the mansion and survive through it!

title: Hyperspace: Andy's Adventure
description: Hyperspace: Andy’s Adventure is a single player space adventure that anyone who can rely on their reflexes can play. Now, sit back, put on your headphones and get ready for the challenge!

title: Moki
description: Moki is a precision platformer with psychological elements, a story of a little guy lost in your own mind, do you be able to leave this mindness prison?

title: Vaporwave
description: A calm and empty place, slow and relaxing music, a very special feeling of nostalgia for a version of the 90s that you have not known ... Welcome to the world of Vaporwave!

title: Uberlaufer
description: You are a German solider in 1940 who opposed the Third Reich. Incarcerated by the SS, you must escape the procedurally-generated dungeon with the assistance of the German resistance using environmental clues to avoid detection by guards. Every playthrough is different.

title: Omega Blade
description: Shoot, slash, dodge and survive to blade combats in multiple kind of challenges to test your skills and claim your place in the Omega Blade hall of fame.

title: Tornado Driver
description: Endless runner game with different environments and objects being randomly generated.

title: Niconotes the Whoo!
description: Help the magical musical NicoNotes fly back into their nests!

description: Invade strange worlds with alien armies! populate and shield your planets! Assassinate, Sabotage and Nuke your opponents! Collect victory points and achieve... PLANETARY CONTROL!

description: FimbulWinter is a first-person horror game in a scandinavian style. The game revolves around a hermit who just try to survive.

title: Arc Wizards 2
description: The war of the wizards begins! This is a shooting action game!

title: Elmarion: The Lost Temple
description: “Elmarion: the Lost Temple” is a first-person party RPG. The player plays in a squad of 4 adventurers, choosing from 8 different classes. During the game, the squad explores the dungeons, clears them of monsters, and solves puzzles. Purpose of the game: to get an ancient powerful artifact.

title: PitBots
description: Physics based combat game where you design a robot and fight in the arena. Crush, flip, pierce, burn and cut your opponents till the last part. Create superior fighting machines and dominate the arena.

title: Woebegone Woods
description: Woebegone Woods is a casual worker placement game with a focus on relationship building. Enter the Woebegone Woods, a small, warm village in the middle of a cold and remote forest!

description: Time travel to the past as Detective Cobie Cromwell. Find clues and solve puzzles in this story rich, immersive, virtual reality escape room game. Game to be released in successive chapters, with four total planned.

So toss them a ladder, dig a path, place a bridge, or blast a wall. Get them home safely in this medium skill platformer. Use your brain, they won’t use theirs!

title: Orion: The Eternal Punishment
description: Orion is a frantic first person shooter where you fight the void creatures in mysterious planets and advance using your special abilities and gadgets.

title: Block Machine
description: Block Machine is an elimination-style Roguelike game inspired by Tetris and slot machines. Pull down the lever. You will complete the elimination through random choices again and again, obtaining more items and achieving higher scores.

title: ZombiesWaves
description: Your friend is blocked! Eliminate the zombies - Open all the doors - Help your friend.

title: Fusion Relics
description: Fusion Relics: A 2D side-scrolling, creature collector, RPG platformer with arcade hack and slash mechanics, hand drawn art, and character customization, where you battle giant titans, hatch unique creatures, and restore the balance between Light and Dark to a corrupted world!

title: Death Roads: Tournament
description: Combine deadly racing, deckbuilding, and roguelite style to get car battles unlike anything before! Choose a driver, car, weapons, and sponsors to overcome tactical encounters. Adapt to an ever-changing race to come out on top and earn entry into the last safe haven on the Divided States of America.

title: Map Game: Or Something
description: An action platformer game that involves drawing maps and playing through cool and epic levels with really cool and awesome and creative design.

New gameplay features including a new Tributary system, Chinese Mercenaries, and much more will make the Transoxiana and India regions come alive with...

description: What does one do when a girl appears, claiming to be a god? For college student Jeong Lee-Han, his life suddenly becomes turned upside down by the appearance of the god, Hana. A supernatural love comedy visual novel with multiple endings.

description: 15-year-old Avani is tricked into starting an anti-science mob to pay off her mother's medical debts. Use classic turn-based tactics to convince the town to join your cause. It's silly. title: Witch and Spirit
description: Play Hide and Seek in the Mistery Land with friends in Compete Mode or Collaborate Mode.

title: I am Dictator
description: Become dictator of the only country that does not yield to the world's superpowers. Use your skills to build an army, care for your people, provide wealth and gain worldwide respect. You're a natural-born leader and the best diplomat. We await your orders, Sir!

title: Break It Down
description: Advanced Destruction Physics | Everything is Destructible

title: Smart Moves 2
description: "Smart Moves 2" is a pixel-art puzzle game with turn-based combat mechanics. Different worlds with levels of increasing difficulty, sneaky monsters, unexpected obstacles and great treasures await you. Smart moves are the key to survival!

title: Gurobu
description: "GUROBU" is a story-driven, 2D horror game about haunted apartments, ghosts of the past, and a murder mystery.

title: Vorlaw: Space Opera
description: Vorlaw is our world. Vorlaw is perfection. Vorlaw is order. Vorlaw can't tolerate your poisonous deviant mind. Run away and fight for freedom. No matter how.

title: Carom Billiards
description: Pure skill. No pockets.
