title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Blue Comet
description: The Blue Comet add on pack recreates the excitement and splendour of a truly remarkable train.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CO17-1471 Russian Loco and Tender
description: A series of freight locomotives CO (Sergo Ordzhonikidze, axle load 17 tonnes) designed for medium loads and working on lines with light rail. Built from 1934 to 1951 at the Kharkov, Bryansk, Voroshilovgrad, Krasnoyarsk and Ulan-Ude Locomotive Works. Total production of locomotives - 3049.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CSX EMD SD60
description: This session lets you jump straight in and drive the CSX Transportation EMD SD60 in 'easy' or 'realistic' mode.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: DIC-Reefer (Mechanical Refrigerator)
description: Mechanical Refrigerator (Reefer) have various products and textures, animation, running numbers, and sound.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Avmz Intercity 71
description: Avmz Intercity 1st class passenger high quality car with 2 sessions for the "Niddertalbahn" track complete the package. Get on board and extend your vehicle fleet with these cars, which are rich in detail.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CN GP9 Phase I & II
description: This session allows you to jump in and drive the CN GP9 Phase I and II locomotives in easy or realistic mode.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Southern Pacific AC4400CW 100-299
description: Representation of SP AC4400s between the years 1998-2004. Cabs are exactly created to prototype specs including 2 cab radios and GE/Harris LOCOTROL IV equipment.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: The Innter Kohn Necktion Railroad
description: The Innter Kohn Necktion Railroad has both a standard gauge and narrow gauge for this superb TRS19 model railroad layout.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Victorian Railways V Class 2 Tone Green
description: Built by the Phoenix Foundry in Ballarat, Victoria, between 1900 and 1901, the V class was the first 2-8-0 locomotive class on the Victorian Railways, designed for use on branch lines around Victoria, and was a predecessor to the K class and J class locomotives.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: EMD SD40-2 - Maersk
description: Experience the power of the Maersk SD40-2 with custom cab!

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: QJ Steam Locomotive
description: Experience one of the most powerful Chinese locomotives ever made with the China Railway QJ class locomotive.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: NS SD60E - 6920 Veterans Unit
description: Experience the power of the NS SD60E - 6920 Veterans Unit as you shunt the yard and make your freight run!

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: The Broadway Limited
description: 3DZUG is taking you back to the golden ages of the American railroads and brings you one of the most famous US trains, Pennsylvania Railroad's "Broadway Limited".

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Amtrak P42DC - Phase III
description: Amtrak P42DC locomotive in Phase III livery. Feature full custom cab, automatic running numbers, animated wipers, gecko script, and more.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CO17-4173 Russian Loco and Tender
description: A series of freight locomotives CO (Sergo Ordzhonikidze, axle load 17 tonnes) designed for medium loads and working on lines with light rail. Built from 1934 to 1951 at the Kharkov, Bryansk, Voroshilovgrad, Krasnoyarsk and Ulan-Ude Locomotive Works. Total production of locomotives - 3049.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Leadville Subdivision
description: A rural and largely single track connection between UP and BNSF owned main lines.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Newcastle Shunter
description: Shunt several coal cars, car carriers and cement hoppers around TYNE the massive rail yard just outside Newcastle station. Full scripted shunting session with cut-scenes and audio task details and commentary.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Rheingold 1962
description: It was the German equivalent to the famous Orient Express - the exquisite Rheingold.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Chicago North Western GE Dash 9 44CW
description: This session lets you jump straight in and drive the Chicago North Western GE Dash 9 44CW in 'easy' or 'realistic' mode.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Japan - Model Trainz
description: This layout is inspired by the Okayama Prefecture, Japan. It is designed for busy train traffic, and features a great range of challenging sessions. There are also some display cabinets where you can put trains on for stationary display.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Trainz Route - Rostovsky Uzel
description: The route is based on a real section of the North Caucasian railway, located in the Rostov region of the Russian Federation.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: US ATC Class S 160 Steam
description: This pack contains two versions of this unique steam locomotive, as well as one session for the "Kickstarter County" route. Treat yourself to something special, sniff the air of yesteryear and drive one of the locomotives built in great quantities in days gone past.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CO17-1171 Russian Loco and Tender
description: A series of freight locomotives CO (Sergo Ordzhonikidze, axle load 17 tonnes) designed for medium loads and working on lines with light rail. Built from 1934 to 1951 at the Kharkov, Bryansk, Voroshilovgrad, Krasnoyarsk and Ulan-Ude Locomotive Works. Total production of locomotives - 3049.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Canadian Rocky Mountains - Rogers Pass
description: Rogers Pass is one of those subsections that will submerge you in sheer beauty and awe regarding landscape and railways - the Rocky Mountains at its majestic best! Route includes 4 Sessions.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CO17-4171 Russian Loco and Tender
description: A series of freight locomotives CO (Sergo Ordzhonikidze, axle load 17 tonnes) designed for medium loads and working on lines with light rail. Built from 1934 to 1951 at the Kharkov, Bryansk, Voroshilovgrad, Krasnoyarsk and Ulan-Ude Locomotive Works. Total production of locomotives - 3049.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Legacy of the Burlington Northern II
description: Legacy of the BN II is a beautifully mastered proto-fictional route from Jointed Rail. Complete with custom content, locomotive and rolling stock packs this route will provide hours and hours of endless fun and entertainment.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Union Pacific GE C40-8
description: The GE C40-8 is a 6-axle diesel-electric locomotive built by GE Transportation Systems between 1987 and 1992. It is part of the GE Dash 8 Series of freight locomotives, and its wheel arrangement is of a C-C type. his locomotive model is often referred to as a Dash 8-40S or simply "Dash 8".

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CO17-4373 Russian Loco and Tender
description: A series of freight locomotives CO (Sergo Ordzhonikidze, axle load 17 tonnes) designed for medium loads and working on lines with light rail. Built from 1934 to 1951 at the Kharkov, Bryansk, Voroshilovgrad, Krasnoyarsk and Ulan-Ude Locomotive Works. Total production of locomotives - 3049.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: SNCF - AGC Languedoc
description: The AGC trains were designed by Bombardier. These railcars feature a modular interior and flexible power options (diesel, electric, or hybrid 'bi-mode' versions). The version included is a hybrid Diesel + 1500v DC version in 'Languedoc' livery and is now available to add to your Trainz collection.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CO17-1374 Russian Loco and Tender
description: A series of freight locomotives CO (Sergo Ordzhonikidze, axle load 17 tonnes) designed for medium loads and working on lines with light rail. Built from 1934 to 1951 at the Kharkov, Bryansk, Voroshilovgrad, Krasnoyarsk and Ulan-Ude Locomotive Works. Total production of locomotives - 3049.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: British Rail Class 70 - Colas Rail
description: Drive the highly detailed, modern British GE Class 70 in Colas Rail livery in Trainz. Developed by 3DZUG for TRS19 using the latest PBR technologies, and many custom features!

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Canadian Rocky Mountains Viktor Lake to Ross Peak and Glacier
description: Drive through the Canadian Rocky Mountains between Viktor Lake, through the famous CPR McDonald and Connaught tunnels, to Ross Peak and Glacier.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CSX Transportation GE B30-7
description: This Downloadable Content Pack includes the highly detailed CSX GE B30-7 model for use in the Trainz Simulator franchise games.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: DBuz 747 Passenger Cars
description: The cars are still to be found on Germany's railways today. They are the backbone of local traffic: the famous double-deck car, affectionately known as 'Dostos' for short.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Victorian Railways D1 Class (Type 4 - Newport) Black
description: Victorian Railways D1 class (Type 4- Wide Cab) 4-6-0 tender locomotives in all over black.

title: Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 2: Collector's Edition
description: Return to the amazing undersea world of Atlantis Solitaire for a new adventure! Embark on a journey across 600 (!) oceanic levels and restore 10 magnificent seascapes. Unravel 24 solitaire variants and enjoy the all-new supersize and challenge levels.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Canadian Rocky Mountains - Columbia River Basin
description: The beautiful Canadian Rocky Mountain - Columbia River Basin covers a staggering 2000 sq km making it one of the largest routes ever created in Trainz. Includes 6 sessions!

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Beavermouth to Ottertail
description: This route extends the beautiful landscapes of the Rocky Mountains by expanding the original Canadian Rocky Mountains - Columbia River Basin route.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Cornish Mainline & Branches
description: The Cornish Main Line was originally built by two separate railway companies, the West Cornwall Railway between Truro and Penzance, opened in 1852, and the Cornwall Railway between Plymouth and a separate station in Truro, opened in 1859.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Brazemore Yard
description: The Brazemore Yard has fantastic track work that hugs lush rolling hills to give the feeling of driving through the countryside.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Japan - Model Trainz
description: This layout is inspired by the Okayama Prefecture, Japan. It is designed for busy train traffic, and features a great range of challenging sessions. There are also some display cabinets where you can put trains on for stationary display.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Franklin Avenue Industrial
description: Franklin Avenue Industrial is a small one baseboard Model Railroadz route inspired by the track plan, 59th Street Branch by Stan Sweatt as featured in Model Railroader Workshop Tips. Franklin Ave is located in Anywhere USA but contains mostly North Eastern influence.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Rostovsky Uzel
description: The route is based on a real section of the North Caucasian railway, located in the Rostov region of the Russian Federation.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: The Shorts and Kerl Traction Railroad
description: The Shortz & Kerl Railroad was an electrified short line that began freight services in the early part of the Twentieth Century, linking Port Shortz with the Kerl Iron Works.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Mojave Sub Division
description: The Mojave Sub Division. Known for its rolling hills, drop off cliffs, and the famous Tehachapi Loop. This route is challenging with its constant grade changes, up to a ruling grade of 2.2%, but yet satisfying with its mixture of desert and mountainous scenery colors.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Bea-Dawe Model Railway
description: This British Diesel-era layout includes several stations, goods yards and engine facilities and was inspired by memories of growing up in the Midlands spending many hours standing on the side of the Lickey Bank with Granddad watching the trains go past.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Balezino Mosti
description: A route in the extent of 57 km between Balezino and Mosti, Russia. Beautifully detailed landscapes and an electrified railway connect these two cities.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Midwestern Branch
description: Midwestern Branch is a fictional route based somewhere in the Midwestern section of the US. While the main line is owned and operated by BNSF, the branch line uses ex-Milwaukee Road units in both SD40-2 and GP38-2 styles to help serve the industries that are in the towns of Littleport, Levitt, Cylinder, and Mill Town.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Fall Harvest Nebraska
description: It is harvest time again, long grain trains moving through typical Nebraska farming country to bring in this year's harvest. The Route centres on North Platte Nebraska, including the Bailey Yard.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Port Zyd & Fulazturn Railroad
description: An industrial layout on an industrial scale! The Port Zyd & Fulazturn Railroad represents a busy and thriving railroad serving a large harbor and industrial area, moving freight cars around on behalf of a Class 1 railroad. The Class 1 railroad delivers and picks up freight cars at the Transfer Yard.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Appen
description: "Appen" is a fictitious route set in West Yorkshire (or should I say the West Riding) in the 1950 - 60's. Appen represents an industrial town located between Leeds and Bradford served by the London Midland with services from the North Eastern region of British Railways.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Chiyoda Branch Line
description: The Chiyoda Branch Line is the Tokyo Metro Line in Tokyo, Japan. This route will bring you the landscape of Japan's suburban city.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Niddertalbahn
description: An idyllic, single-track branch line in Wetterau- and Main-Kinzig-Kreis - and best of all it's free!

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Belarusian Woodland
description: The Belarusian woodlands is a beautiful landscape featuring many forests, lakes and rivers. Includes 4 sessions plus a bonus steam locomotive - CO17-1171.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Legacy of the Burlington Northern II
description: Legacy of the BN II is a beautifully mastered proto-fictional route from Jointed Rail. Complete with custom content, locomotive and rolling stock packs this route will provide hours and hours of endless fun and entertainment.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Coal Country
description: Welcome to Coal Country! Take a trip through the heart of the Appalachian coal fields. This fictional route is complete with a brand new Railroad, locomotives, rolling stock, and scenery items.

title: Trainz: A New Era - Route: Settle and Carlisle
description: Updated for TANE - Settle & Carlisle takes you to one of the most famous and scenic British main lines at the time of the transition from steam to diesel power. 25 sessions across 5 routes with all with new speedtrees and procedural tracks this is one you'll want to pick up and drive!

title: Toys & Physics
description: "Toys & Physics" is a side-view physics puzzle game. The goal is to collect stars and to get your ball to the basket.

title: Mage Hunters
description: Mage Hunters uses capture and elimination mechanics in the best style of classic board games. You control three Hunters that must eliminate the evil Mages. Each move counts for you complete the mission.

title: Zball IV
description: Zball IV is a new physics puzzle game. The goal is to deliver the green ball to the green platform. It sounds simple, but actually it is not. This game has new portals mechanics!

title: Link Wars
description: Link Wars is a multiplayer real-time board game with an extra single player puzzle campaign.

title: Master of Miracles
description: 《奇迹领主》是一款以魔兽与奇幻为题材的策略养成游戏。玩家作为一名指挥官，培养自己的军队。尝试自己的流派和打法，在剧情，探险，比赛，资源争夺模式中尽情体验无与伦比的乐趣。

title: Flaming/Million
description: A new RPG found in this flaming dumpster: undo this curse of toxic masculinity upon yr college campus through the power of glitches.

title: Pemsa
description: Pemsa is a cart runner for the famous PICO-8 fantasy console. We've included the classic games developed for this console, including Celeste, Slipways & Hug Arena.

title: EyeRoll
description: You are the glass eye of a very forgetful explorer and you must solve the long lost secrets of an ancient ruin to find your way out of the maze. The genre is fantasy puzzle solving while rolling a glass eye through a maze. Discover forgotten secrets in a lost world behind the Bermuda Triangle.

title: Pavlov's House
description: Take control of the valiant defenders of a Soviet strongpoint in Stalingrad as they hold out against constant German attacks for almost two months. Can you rise to the challenge of mounting odds and hold Pavlov’s House?

title: Base Jump
description: Base Jump is a fast-paced competitive action platformer available for one or two players locally.

title: Futuclass Chemistry VR
description: Futuclass teaches the subjects of Basic Chemistry through gamified experiences in Virtual Reality. Please be aware the learning modules are not included in the "Futuclass Chemistry VR" game and have to be bought separately as DLC-s.

title: Drift Phonk 666
description: You have to collect all the PHONK mixtapes straight from hell so people hear how good 𝖒𝖚𝖘𝖎𝖈 sounds.

title: Shuttle Commander
description: Take command of the Space Shuttle as it embarks on various missions to the Hubble Space Telescope. Fly the shuttle in a full landing simulation based on real physics and flight dynamics.

title: Mad Taxi
description: MAD TAXI is a top-view game that will test your reaction and concentration. You are driving a mad taxi driver in a drunken state. Enjoy!

title: Race: Total Toon Race
description: Total Toon RaceRace with Formula like cars. Hit the speed pads to gain more speed for a limited time.Start one of the challenging championships.Race against CPU Player, or PvP on the same PC.Listen to great Rock Soundtrack

title: Mess Adventures
description: An abnormal adventure game in nonsensical style. It contains a variety of game elements (even fighting battles, tank battles, puzzles,sokobans, flying shooting, etc.). It is very suitable to recommend it to friends who you want to prank them, live broadcast, or entertain yourself.

title: BreakBlast
description: Break blocks, power-up, score, fight bosses and then break some more blocks. Use all your ability to get to the end of this game with the highest score. The level design and bosses will give you a challenge to maintain your score and your lives. Are you fast? You'll need to be on BreakBlast!

title: Little Martian
description: Little Martian is a game of exploration, resource-gathering, base-building, and survival. You have crash-landed on an uninhabited planet and your spaceship is very badly damaged. You'll need to find the resources to repair and rebuild all of the destroyed parts.

title: Clash of Warlords
description: Join the Epic Battles in this most addicting turn-based strategy war-chess game with thrilling, mind-challenging gameplay which will keep war-chess game fans gripped for hours.

title: Aquillanto
description: Aquillanto is a 2D platformer with super-tight controls. Craft ink-shooting magical pens to slay the hordes of monsters you will encounter and master the controlled platforms to win! Three worlds to explore, tons of fun challenges, missions to go on... and a Gold Pen to be found!

title: The Great Empire: Relic of Egypt
description: Stop a fuming pharaoh from ravaging an island paradise and send his mummified army scrambling for safety as you rebuild and defend your land!

title: Gǒudàn Shénmàoxiǎn: Hěn Shǎ Hěn Tiānzhēn
description: A "very silly very naive" dog egg game

title: Cerevrum
description: Cerevrum is a new approach to learning in virtual reality! Using his intelligence, a player steps in conflict of Gods in the world of Enuma. The challenge of the first game - to destroy hordes of enemy's spaceships! In second game player defends Soul Crystals from enemies.

title: Quantum Paradox
description: Quantum Paradox is a single-user story modification for Half-Life 2 Episode 2, which takes place in post-apocalyptic St. Petersburg. There are not so many allies among the survivors, but there are a lot of enemies!

title: Jerry Wanker and the Quest to get Laid
description: Tonight is the night! Next door at the spooky mansion, the hottest girls in Blueball Falls are throwing the hottest and sexiest party in history!

title: Butterfly 3: Funny Twins
description: The third part of the puzzle-platformer Butterfly - Funny Twins! 40 steps to victory with these funny twins! Bounce off enemies, climb into pipes, measure distance, use obstacles to complete levels without misfire.

title: Happy Z-Day
description: Today is supposed to be your daughter's birthday, But something happened in this town. Almost everyone has turn into a Monster. You need to protect your daughter and her birthday party!

title: Hexcraft: Harlequin Fair
description: Harlequin Fair is an experimental RPG and immersive sim set in the shadows of Toronto by night. Cast dreadful spells, buy small arms with cash: cling to the light 'til the light bites you back

title: Cyberplug
description: Cyberplug is a 2D platformer, where you control an electric being capable of moving at high speed and use electricity to advance through enemies and destroy a corporation that rules the cyberpunk themed city.

title: Heaven Dust 2
description: Deep inside a research base, waking up from a cryogenic pod, you find yourself trapped in a living hell, surrounded by zombies. Heaven Dust 2 is a love letter to classic survival horror games featuring exploration, action, puzzles, and resource management.

title: Dark Runner
description: Parkour, speedrun and darkness. This combination is quite a challenge. Unique lighting mechanics like you've never seen before are the main reason you'll want this game to never end.

title: Life as Designed
description: A feeling of being typecast and a dwindling motivation to work leaves Cho Fukuda questioning her career as a freelance costume designer. To get out of this rut, Cho and her girlfriend search for a new calling she can devote herself to.

title: Space Soldier
description: Space Soldier is a single-player adventure game, you will play the role of a Protagonist to clear the enemy in the level

title: Quatris
description: Simple rules, surprising results: challenge yourself with a novel twist on a classic.

title: Blocks Stacking
description: Casual/puzzle game where the goal is to get as high as possible placing blocks on top of each other. Controlled by keyboard and mouse or gamepad. 4 difficulty levels make sure that anyone can play it, and for reaching certain goals you will be given cosmetic rewards.

title: The Unmarked
description: This family friendly first person shooter is full of adventure, places to explore, and a story to be unfolded. You explore a incredible hand designed world full of secrets and hidden Items, Your goal is to unfold the story of the lost soldier.

title: Sentinel: Cursed Knight
description: Sentinel: Cursed knight is a single player RPG which sets in the land of Kasweihn. You are a knight of the holy order to investigate what went wrong in the Kasweihn area. The game consists of many abilities, different equipment and a lore rich world to uncover.

title: Pitcher and the Whale
description: A 2D platformer where you control a young fox searching for water to bring to a beached whale. Jump and throw your bucket around to open paths, knock away enemies, and of course, carry water!

title: Castle of the Land
description: A castle is under attack, a group of adventurers in town decide to help defend it to the last man.

title: Run Die Jump
description: Run Die Jump is a platform game where dying can help you move forward. Set your own traps and help to win.

title: Oneteam Soccer
description: Let's play ONETEAM SOCCER. All players move together since they're "ONETEAM".

title: Orbiterrion
description: Match against your friends or team up in a fast-paced, action-packed space fight set in orbits across the Solar System. Use skills, collect shards and kick your friends to outer space!

title: Wrestledunk Sports
description: Wrestledunk is an explosive, colorful collection of super-competitive (or cooperative) multiplayer sports games! Couchslam your friends with full local and online multiplayer support for high-energy athletic action. Four sports, loads of arenas and modes, one champion!

title: Escape the Tank
description: a simple 3d platform game set inside a fish tank. the aim of the game is to escape the tank by exploring the surroundings, avoiding hazards, solving problems and traversing platforms.

title: Sausage Fiesta
description: Sausage Fiesta is a multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. Play as a sausage, compete with your friends and discover all the sausages from all over Europe!

title: Lost & Round
description: Lost & Round is a story-driven, 3D isometric platformer game that requires strategic manipulation of player perspective over lush landscapes in order to complete complex levels filled with obstacles and illusions.

title: Binaural Odyssey
description: See how sounds and shapes help mental health in virtual reality. The aim of Binaural Odyssey is to create and guide the user’s emotions. The virtual world reacts to the eyes of the viewer and creates visual shapes from whichever direction the user looks at.

title: Save Data
description: A byte-sized rogue-lite anti-shoot-em-up! Deflect and shoot down projectiles in 3 worlds of crazy bullet-heck action with semi-randomized room order and an upgrade system that provides a bevy of interesting ways to progress!

title: Medieval Hero
description: Medieval Hero is a fast-paced 2D platformer with many levels and enemies. Take on the role of a Medieval Knight and start crushing your enemies! Immerse yourself in a world full of adventures and dangers.

title: The Legend of Fjarri
description: The Legend of Fjarri is an adventure action game focused on discovering a deep plot full of myths, legends and an ancient fight against an evil foe, all set in a beautiful world for you to explore.

title: The Last King's Archer
description: Survive the night killing enemies using your bow, Fire Dragon or Thunder Dragon special attacks in this wave based 2D platformer packed with a lot of action and upgrades. Can you last until daylight?

title: Humans Vs Ghouls
description: Humans Vs Ghouls is an online top-down shooter following survivors of a ghoul apocalypse that blast foes to live another day.

title: Veiled Basilisk
description: Experience a thrilling ride as you unravel a twisted and branching tale of a science experiment gone wrong in this Sci-fi action FPS game! Early Access version available!

title: Cursed Weekend
description: Cursed Weekend is a game for a group of five players in which: four trapped young people and one sneaking evil. But what kind of evil, this is exactly what you have to find out. Maniac killer, poltergeist, cursed doll, demon or ... You never know for sure.

title: Treasure Tomb VR
description: TreasureTombVR is a VR and First Person adventure game for solo or multiplayer. You must progress through large scale levels by solving puzzles and overcoming challenges to find the long-lost treasure. So, choose your character, gather your friends or go alone, and enter the Treasure Tomb.

title: Project Summit
description: Participate in a frenetic competition to be the first to reach the top before it's too late. Up to 8 players in local multiplayer.

title: Florida Man: Hurricane Hijinks
description: Six hours until the hurricane hits. Six hours alone on a Florida island. Six hours to reach fame! What will your headline be?

title: Kaverini Nuuk Adventures
description: Welcome to Nuuk, the capital of Greenland! Design your own character and hop into the modern and wild sides of the Arctic alike! When trouble arises, from mythical monsters to a computer that won't work, use your emotional techniques to get your way, no violence required! Real life places included!

title: MakerKing
description: Become a King (or Queen) at making levels! Join a community designed around level creation and online play. The level editor is simple to use and lets you create anything, even living creatures!

title: Nak Sim: Fallen Warriors
description: In the world of the cursed sword, defeat aksims have been encroached by the power of darkness, and save who are being used as weapons. They will become your weapon. Uspace who can change the shape of the soul, will make your weapon stronger and give you special powers. 3D Rougelike Action Adventure.

title: Water Drift
description:
Control your boat, as you drift along the track, the stronger and longer the turn, the more points you get! Drive the entire distance gaining as many points as possible.
Reach the finish line as quickly as possible!

title: Manic Archers
description: MANIC ARCHERS is an atmospheric and extremely addictive local and online multiplayer arcade game in Pixel Art-style. It features simplistic and on-the-point gameplay with amazing game mechanics and lovely Pixel Art-details. It is playable with up to four players simultaneously in several variants.

title: VR Treasure Raider
description: After years of research, the entrance to an ancient island has been discovered. Beyond its doors are rumored to be riches guarded by cunning monsters and lethal traps. Be wary or be entombed. Good luck and have fun with virtual reality.

title: Carminia
description: A 2d puzzle game with different mechanics for each world. Swap minds with enemies, destroy terrain with explosions, create clones and summon gusts of wind to solve puzzles.

title: Tiime
description: Rewind time, Stop Bullets or Slow them. Tiime is a Puzzle-Platformer focused on Time manipulation. Missed a step and died? No problem, just rewind yourself through time and pretend this whole thing never happened. Time is literally in your hands!

title: The Corruption Within
description: The Corruption Within is a psychological thriller first-person point & click adventure game set in the Victorian era, with an emphasis on strong narrative, intriguing characters and puzzle-solving.

title: Grim Tales: Threads of Destiny
description: Grim Tales: Threads of Destiny is the the 9th installment of Grim Tales Series by Elephant Games.

title: Peaceful Gunner
description: Peace, love, and... GUNS! Peaceful Gunner is a shooter-defense game about good vibes. Shoot some magical flowers to turn soldiers into hippies and make the world a better place (or not).

title: Utopia Process
description: Pilot two ships to protect the last cities on Earth

title: Burg Battle
description: Burg Battle is a reverse tower defense game by ElevenSeventy. Send your armies to clash with your enemies, destroy their castle, and conquer their lands.

title: My Isekai After Life is an RPG!?
description: You have died. You choose to live your after-life in a turn-based RPG game with no one but beautiful goddesses to talk to. Laugh your way through a comical story-line as you battle monsters, unlock new powers, and recruit goddesses to your party!

title: Rebellion: A Rogue Souls Like
description: Rebellion is a souls like action game, where you are trapped and your only option is to trust your fellow fates! Recruit other prisoners and make your way to escape, face enemies that have handcrafted AI. Explore the corridors of this prison, whose challenges will always be unprecedented.

title: Yupi
description: Run, jump and collect coins .. Yupi has come to save us!

title: Greedy Dungeon
description: Greedy Dungeon is a Deck-Building Roguelike game that you have to build a deck with your playstyle and embark upon a random-generated-dungeon swarming with dangers and favors. Your greed won't punish you, perhaps sometimes would.

title: Endless Furry Asteroids
description: Welcome to Endless Furry Asteroids! The 6th installment of the "Endless Furry" Series!

title: Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 2
description: Return to the amazing undersea world of Atlantis Solitaire for a new adventure! Embark on a journey across more than 600 oceanic levels and restore 10 magnificent seascapes. Unravel 24 solitaire variants and enjoy 150 levels of a fully-featured Mahjong game. Take quests and unlock beautiful fish to populate the ocean. Solve the brand-new supersize and challenge levels as you explore wonderful Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 2.

title: Troublemaker
description: Troublemaker tells the story of friendship, chaos, romance, and strife between school gangs. Defeat the enemy gangs, Seize their territory, And become the ruler of the School in the Strongest High School here.

title: Art of the Rail
description: Spiritual remake of the classic transport tycoon games. Build a profitable transport network and grow your worlds economy, either on your own in singleplayer or in multiplayer whether cooperatively or competitively.

title: Remote Knights Online
description: A faction-based openworld action RPG with survival elements. Playable in multiplayer, singleplayer and self-hosted mode with custom ruleset. Can you survive the rough world of Vall Tir?

title: I Am the Captain Now
description: It's time to form a crew and vote for your captain! Put your friendship to the test in this fast-paced couch co-op game where you must follow your captain or risk being left behind. But remember, for bad leaders mutiny awaits...

title: PhotoWorld
description: PhotoWorld is a calm travel game, the essence of which is to take beautiful photos.

title: Slime Time TD
description: A single-player tower defense game. Stop the slimes from stealing your peaches!

title: Blue June
description: Blue June is a 2.5D story-driven adventure game with elements of exploration, puzzle solving, stealth and horror. Play as June, a student of the prestigious Rose Hill Academy, and uncover the truth that lies beneath her recurring nightmares.

title: Friki
description: Friki is an online co-op investigative horror. Solve the reasons why these ghosts have died, determine a ghost type, and if you are brave enough, exorcise the ghost.

title: Kuro Neko
description: Kuro Neko is a 2D platformer. In Kuro Neko you have got lost and you must find your way home by collecting oil lanterns and avoiding monsters.

title: Tomb Rumble
description: Tomb Rumble is a pixel art MMO platformer, where adventurers compete to retreive ancient treasures in lost temples, cursed ruins and more. Push other players into deadly traps to be the first to escape !... or be the one to fall in a lava pit.

title: Reimu's Weird little adventure
description: A classic 2D RPG Touhou fan game with some bullet hell element and a silly story. Reimu was bored, like, really bored, so she went and beat Cirno up! with a twist, and another twist! actually there are quite some twists. Oh, also, this game is filled with crappy jokes that no one will understand.

title: The Headsman
description: The Headsman is a game about the everyday life and work of an executioner in a medieval city. Enforce punishment, use stocks, flog, hang and behead! Ask questions later...

title: Tag Hop
description: Tag Hop is a fast-paced PvP bunny hop tag game. Hone your movement skills and compete with your friends, or against other real players! Tag Hop has various duel and team-based game modes, which all incorporate tag!

title: A Matter of Time
description: Wield blazing light-blades, harness the extreme power of the ‘Paradox Cape’ and plot an exciting course for an epic adventure to save the universe!

title: Mud and Blood
description: Mud and Blood, the cult classic flash strategy game is back with a vengeance and this time you are on the offensive. This is a brutal real-time strategy game set in World War 2 where you command a small squad of soldiers against impossible odds in a procedural and unforgiving battlefield.

title: Lost Nova
description: Your spaceship crashed on an alien planet. Explore, salvage, craft, trade, manage and upgrade your way back home!

title: Space Mages: Dimension 33
description: Space Mages: D33 is a Space Shooter/Bullet Hell about shoot in aliens with magics and combine elements to make powerfull new elemental magics

title: One Night on Halloween
description: A black and white manga-style visual novel about high school, parties, crushes, best friends and bullies!

title: Flowering Across
description: In the season when the cherry is at full blossom, an ordinary high school girl met a sakura youkai and the story unfolded. This game is a visual novel with multiple storylines and your choices will lead to different endings

title: Click and Relax
description: The game consists of mini-games in which you can move objects, twist the knobs and just relax.

title: Oubey VR: Cosmic Voyage
description: Inside the art - Cosmic Voyage This VR takes you on a cosmic journey through the universe of OUBEYs paintings. Starting on Earth you are led into the far distant depths of space and back...

title: Sinistrous
description: Discover an ancient dungeon and battle eldritch horrors in this Lovecraftian deck-builder. With each new adventure, face a unique and randomized assortment of mystifying events, phantasmal environments, and perplexing creatures.

title: Clockwork Calamity in Mushroom World: What would you do if the time stopped ticking?
description: A gentle exploration platformer in a vast yet small world where time has stopped, what will happen?

title: Drugs and Crime Idle
description: Behind every great fortune lies a great crime! In this idle game the only goal is to make a ton of cash. Drugs, crime, blood, gambling or gang battles, all tools for a drug lord.

title: La Ultima Comida
description: Zombies are everywhere and have been determined to make you their LAST FOOD. There are so many that you don't know if the slow steps and moans you hear come from the end of the hall or from the next corner.

title: Mister Universe
description: In this game you have to go through a difficult path - from a mere mortal to Mr. Universe, the legend of sports and cinema, whose list is achievements updated in real time.

title: Evolution of a Mini World: Physics Wonderland
description: We have built a mini universe with real physics basis, simulation and imagination. The game uses realistic environments and models to tell a story of a mini universe.

title: The Palace on the Hill
description: An open-world adventure, exploration game where you tend to your farm, talk to villagers and collect stories from them to make beautiful Indian miniature inspired paintings in your own unique way.

title: Descent Vector: Space Runner
description: Descend at extreme speed through a deadly sci-fi gauntlet in Descent Vector, a high-intensity endless runner where precision, destruction, and mastery collide. Smash through space stations, survive relentless acceleration, and compete for global leaderboard dominance.

title: Gravity run
description: Run to the finish line across planets and space objects

title: Flain: Tao force & Cubes
description: Pair and collect the floating cubes using Tao force. It may be a very hard game. Check your progress step by step and eventually reach the wisdom of Tao force.

title: Blood of Darkness
description: Blood of Darkness is a hardcore 2D shooter about a lustful alcoholic priest who was revived by the devil, and this was his biggest mistake!

title: Billionworlds : Kingdoms
description: Lightweight turn based civilization type strategy game, with a great single player experience, but with a focus on multiplayer!

title: Radio Viscera
description: Radio Viscera is a fast-paced top down shooter without bullets. Hurl enemies into brutal traps and blast your way through walls with your air cannon, in this bloody, arcade action game.

title: Host 714
description:
In Host 714, you are going to live as Squid, a drug addicted hobo who was invited by a governmental organization, the Orange Institute, to join a drug addiction rehab center with experimental treatment and social reintegration.
Arriving at the Institute on a faraway island, Squid realizes that the proposal was not what they claimed to be. Now you are a test subject, with an uncertain fate. Help our protagonist escape from the Orange Institute in this challenging stealth game!

title: Untitled Space Game
description: A retro space themed local multiplayer PvP game which prioritises skill over luck. Kill your friends, get better weapons, kill them more, repeat!

title: Duke Nukem Forever 2013
description: A demake of Duke Nukem Forever on Eduke32, Restoring parts of the old storyline and set pieces from the 2001 E3 trailer.

title: Zolaris
description: In the first person stealth shooter, Zolaris, Valeria and her spirit companion, Pike, set out to steal the ancient artifact, Zolaris, from a group known as The Cult of the End in order to save her little sister, Velvet.

title: Cute Animals Memory Card Game
description: Match pairs of cards with pictures of cute animals. With two game modes.

title: Mystery Trackers: Paxton Creek Avenger - Collector's Edition
description:
Someone's made it their personal vendetta to bring down the Mystery Trackers.

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:
• Return to the theater to save a film crew in the bonus game.
• Collect musicians and listen to them play in your own orchestra.
• Earn special achievements and find morphing objects.
• Get the available Strategy Guide.
• Enjoy soundtracks, wallpaper, and concept art.

title: What's Different?
description: Get ready to challenge your eyes and sharpen your focus in What’s Different?, the ultimate visual puzzle game! Each level presents two seemingly identical images, but look closer. Small changes, subtle shifts, and sneaky edits are hiding in plain sight. Whether you prefer the pressure of Challenge Mode or the calm pace of Casual Mode, every round offers a satisfying mix of focus, fun, and “how did I miss that?!” moments. With clean visuals, simple controls, and that irresistible “just one more level” feeling, What’s Different? is the perfect game for anyone who loves puzzles, precision, and a good test of perception.

title: Card Tower Defence
description: Poker + Blackjack + Tower Defense = Card Tower Defense You can enjoy the fun of card games and the fun of tower defense. Towers can be combined using the rules of poker. Towers can be sold using the rules of Blackjack. 20 Stage, 20 Mission, 31 Ability, 60 Types Tower, 8 Types Monster.

title: Slobbish Dragon Princess
description: After discovering a strange, lizard-like being on the side of the road, things start to change for Takeru. And wouldn’t you know it, that lizard was actually the princess of the dragons! Now begins their bizarre, yet down to earth daily life.

title: Slobbish Dragon Princess Love + Plus
description: Haru and the gang are back in Slobbish Dragon Princess Love + PLUS! Enjoy three short stories for Haru, Suzuka and Dorami which takes place after the events of Slobbish Dragon Princess.

title: Gopnik
description: Do you want to feel like a native of Russia in the mid-90s? Then this game is for you.

title: 3 Cushion Masters
description: 3cushion masters is a Billiards game with very interesting leveled stages.

title: Antonball Deluxe Lite
description:
A free-to-play version of Antonball Deluxe.

The breakout title from Summitsphere, Antonball Deluxe is a retro, high-octane smorgasbord of ballbusting arcade action! Antonball Deluxe quite literally turns the breakout genre on its head, blending traditional brick-breaking gameplay with tight, intense platforming.

title: Wilford: Deep Underground
description:
A top down action game that plays like games of the 1980s and 1990s.

Help Wilford collect as many riches as possible, while delving deeper and deeper underground. Balance the time you spend collecting valuables and finding the exit. Levels get harder and harder as you go. Get the best score you can and challenge your friends to do better.

title: Crazy Flasher 7: Mercenary Empire
description: The end is coming, the zombies are rampant, the horizontal battle is refreshing, fighting, cold weapons, firearms, skills, mercenaries...retro graphics, classic old games from 2011 made by AndyLaw!

title: RealFit (VR fitness)
description: RealFit provides custom bodyweight training workouts with added games and stats to keep you motivated. Free your workout from the confines of your living room - get moving in VR with RealFit.

title: Travel Solar
description: This game is to drive the spacecraft to explore the 9 planets in the solar system, such as: Venus, earth, Mars, Jupiter, etc.

title: Missing Time
description: A missing Girl. A collection of Cassette Tapes. Claims of Alien Abduction. A Found footage style game with Audio Recordings and Dream-like gameplay sections.

title: True Spring Love
description: True Spring Love is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's The Devil in the Belfry - Collector's Edition
description:
Can you save an old friend from a deadly legend in time?

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

Help Louise Wheeler’s clever children free their mother from jail, and save their Illusion Theater from criminal Benjamin Barlow. Join their quest for their father’s will and an ancient hidden treasure!
Find magic cards and puzzle pieces throughout the game – and access an extra puzzle and stories.
Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games - and add to your achievement awards!
Save your favorite Tale in the Belfry twists with screensavers, wallpapers, concept art, and music.
Keep your adventure on track with the strategy guide!

title: Adventure Minesweeper
description: A traditional RPG with a landmine game

title: Big City Rigs: Garbage Truck Driver
description: Whoever said collecting trash won't pay the bills? Hop in the seat of your very own garbage truck and clean up and collect the trash as you manage your own waste utilization company.

title: Discovery Yard Police
description: Discovery Yard Police is a game where you and your friends will face each other in a unique TeamDeathmatch, neutralizing enemies in different locations, choosing the best strategy and making decisions that make matches always different!

title: Exotium: Episode 4
description: In this episode, Mr. Harris will discover that certain technologies are much more advanced than he thought and that the field of possibilities is much greater than he imagined.

title: How to Win: Season One
description: How to Win is an anarchic adventure/gaming experiment where players decide the rules. Whatever you decide, that’s what happens next in our story. No matter what chaos it creates. Play through all 5 chapters of Season 1, then send us your ideas for Season 2!

title: UC Kart
description: UC KART is a racing game. There is HP in the car. When HP reaches 0, the game is over. Equipped with a color edit function, you can change the color of the car and driver. In single play, you will play against the CPU. It supports online play, and you can play against other players online.

title: Valor and Glory: Napoleonic Wars
description: Take on the campaign and lead one of 5 factions in an epic war to defend your lands and drive out the enemies.

title: Occupy Mars: Prologue
description: Occupy Mars: Prologue is an introduction to the world of Occupy Mars in which you have to use your brain in order to survive. The Prologue tells a separate story in a closed location and shows a sneak-peek of the full game mechanics.

title: Pirate Popper VR
description: Play our take on the first Bubble Buster game in VR.

title: Barbaros
description: Barbaros: True story on a large and mysterious island will take you deep into the history of piracy and the greatest treasure in the history of piracy. For this cause, you must do everything necessary and be the sole ruler of the seas. The continuation of piracy depends entirely on size.

title: Lucid Soul
description: A villain protagonist, high fantasy, horror RPG in which you, the player, will control Scythe and his party of Deathtouched as they take part in a story rich conquest through the world of Trebezia. Gods and Goddesses will try to stop you... but hey you're the villain... and being evil is so. Much. Fun.

title: Yoshiwara Higanbana
description: --Whether I end up after falling in love, in your arms or in a scarlet prison? It's up to you to make my vow of higanbana fall or wither-- Even if it's only for one night, I want to be held by you...

title: Game Dev Company
description: Game Dev Company is a simulation of game dev company, where you can build company, add furniture,build develop department ,Develop your own games to make money and make your company the most famous game company.

title: Logic: Electrons Connect
description: Logical game for meditation in which you need to connect all of the electrons among themselves.

title: Harts Island
description: Northeast Bronx, New York City. The remains of more than one million people are buried on Harts Island.

title: Taskforce: The Mutants of October Morgane
description: Taskforce is a tactical, turn based game in which you control a small group of elite soldiers in a series of sci-fi themed missions. Mission objectives might include rescuing hostages, blowing up targets, stealing documents or other military activities.

title: Anime Play Life: Unlimited
description: Anime Play Life: Unlimited is an adventure and second life simulation game, where you are able to do quests with your character created in the "Character Creation" in any location, find a job and work there, buy, place and customize your own houses, fish on any lake or sea and much more...

title: Capital Command
description: A single-player space battleship simulator with slow, tense 3d battles and complex, realistic weapons. Manage and upgrade your ship, or capture something better. Play a campaign defending against a ruthless attack, or set up custom battles. Victory requires skill, clever tactics and heavy firepower.

title: Park Alien: A ludo in the space
description: A ludo in the space, in which you play with aliens? What more you can ask for?

title: City of Ragdolls
description: Create your own ragdolls wars in your own city in Sandbox Mode, play with guns, melee weapons, crazy vehicles and so much more. Simply enjoy everything you love about ragdolls!

title: Taisho x Alice Epilogue
description: This is the final installment of Taisho x Alice, a fairytale visual novel in which you must save your Prince Charming! Take on the role of the heroine in order to rehabilitate your chosen love interest and guide him to his "happily ever after" once and for all!

title: TC Strikers 2
description: Touhou-like 2D shooting!!! Chubby protagonist!! Orthodox and easy to understand operation!

title: Sword Story
description: Challenge powerful monsters in the game, experience a thrilling adventure

title: Plataforma branca
description: Find the key to reveal the plataforma branca.

title: Cpt. Balloney: Painful days at home
description: Play as a former captain (of a space ship) on the run in the frist part "painful days at home" when your ship crashed and you had to hide inside the home of some unknown guy. Enjoy a gameplay with no hassle, as time doesn't matter here, promise.

title: My Neighborhood Arcade
description: • Play a rotating set of free to play casual games from many forms of game-play • Listen to hours of high-quality game music across genres • Collect games via DLC purchases to build your customized arcade experience

title: Genius At Work!
description: Test your intelligence and creativity! With Genius At Work you will have your construction area where you can let your imagination fly and carry out your technical projects.

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's The Devil in the Belfry
description:
Amax Interactive is proud to bring you the newest chilling mystery in the Dark Tales series!

When a series of strange deaths occur in the town of Morden, an old friend jumps on the case. But it’s not long before he goes missing himself! You and Dupin quickly arrive to find a town in panic. Each night, someone dies after the 13th chime of the bell tower. And to top things off, no one can be seen ringing the bell itself! Is a sinister specter to blame, or are illusions wreaking havoc on reality? Find out in this stirring Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

title: Indigo 7
description: Indigo 7 is a color-based single-player and multiplayer game. As you follow the plot through comic-style cinematics, you’ll face different battles and unlock a lot of single-player and local PVP modes that tell the rest of the story. The match rules vary in each mode, but the challenge always stays the same: choose a number of colors to use and make the board yours before your opponent does!

title: Pokémon and the Last Wish
description:
Pokémon and the Last Wish is a fan made Pokémon game. It is not a ROM hack, but rather a game made in RPG Maker XP, using the Pokemon Essentials kit.

"Every 1000 years a comet appears in the night sky.
It can only be seen for seven days before it disappears again,
for another 1000 years. "The Millennium Comet" is a special type of comet,
containing an immense amount of energy.
It is said that this energy has the power to awaken 'The Wishmaker'."

This game was made by Voltseon and ENLS.

title: Star Hunter DX
description: Betrayed by her cut-throat crew, Luna Starr - former Space Pirate Captain turned bounty hunter - has a score to settle. As Luna, travel to 5 exotic planets to track down your mutinous mates, and face them in Bullet Hell dogfights to the death!

title: Greats of the Gridiron
description: Greats of the Gridiron is a football simulation experience where must Outdraft, Outdesign, and Outcoach other coaches to stake your claim to Greatness.

title: Buck Up and Drive!
description: Buck Up And Drive! is an endless driving game inspired by arcade classics, with simple yet intense gameplay featuring a total slap in the face of realism. It includes procedurally generated track with multiple environments to visit, ranging from the somewhat realistic to the completely absurd.

title: Ahoy
description: First person multiplayer action/adventure game set during the Age of Sail. Providing an authentic interactive experience of the 18th century Caribbean through sailing, combat, trade and social mechanics.

title: Tic-Tac-Crow
description: This is a little ambient bird garden simulator that evolves as you play. Birds come and go, and in the meantime you can play tic-tac-toe with them.

title: Iris: A Colorful Dream
description:
In a world without its colors, stories are told about a time when life was bright and radiant, when the sunlight was warm and nature was strong. While Iris is still young and their world has always been dull and faded, these stories inspire them to dream of a better future. Could these dreams be a sign of change?

Join Iris as they adventure through the unknown in search of the six lost crystals to make the world colorful once again!

title: Roguely
description: Roguely is a fantasy themed, top-down shooter, pixel art, action roguelite with some bullet hell thrown in. Fight and dodge your way through the randomly generated levels to rescue your friends. Find upgrades along the way and save up arcane fragments for permanent blessings from the gods.

title: Kanso
description:
Kanso is a relaxing line following game of motion, pause, and flow.
Avoid obstacles while you trace around circular forms. Immerse into a colourfully ambient space, effortlessly glide through each of the worlds, and find your moment of Zen.

title: Hello Engineer
description: Unleash your creativity in a multiplayer machinery-construction game in the Hello Neighbor universe! Scavenge, craft, and overcome challenges in the bizarre world of a mysterious amusement park. Put together incredible machines built of scrap, and challenge your creepy Neighbor and his evil bots.

title: Dates & Wires
description:
The year is 1995, and you're newly single, ready to mingle... and fresh off the plane in Stradania, the dysfunctional micronation whose chief exports are pig iron, human misery, and radioactive souvenir mugs. Your travel guides have steered you to the hottest nightclub in town. Now it's up to you to seize the evening by getting up close and intimate with Stradania's Most Eligible Vaguely Handsome Self-Absorbed Guys You Happened to Spot in the Club.

Dates & Wires is the official otome spin-off of weekly webcomic Drugs & Wires, featuring the music of NINGEN.

title: Touhou Blooming Chaos 2
description: Touhou Blooming Chaos 2 is an brand new rogue shooter where you control a character of a varied cast to explore an all randomized labyrinth

description: The Danger Zone is a post-apocalyptic 2.5D shooter with a side view and elements of survival in the unique style of "eternal sunset".

title: Stride.net
description: Stride.net is an online multiplayer Stride mode where players can find endless fun competing in various battles in urban environments perfectly tailored for parkour action.

title: Thrice in a row: A new adventure
description: Continuation of the great puzzle. Available 28 completely new levels. Thrice in a row is a logic game for creating chains of identical elements. The goal of the game is to put in a row from 3 identical elements, get points and go to the next level There are also bonuses.

title: Become a Gladiator VR
description: You start your struggle to survive in the Colosseum without knowing who you are and where slaughtering is just entertainment. In the middle of the Colosseum, all you can rely on is your weapons, shields and skills.

title: Mystery Solitaire: Dreamcatcher
description: Play all the patience games and plunge into the world of dreams!

title: Starboy Adventures
description: Your dog has been kidnapped, and that’s reason enough to kill everyone. Starboy Adventures is a run and gun collectathon where you kill monsters and rescue dogs on a quest for vengeance against the pigeon that stole your puppy.

title: Begie Ade: A lyric of Lie and Retribution
description: Tereza, the captain of kingdom knight, was defeated by the bandit boss Duardo who has got evil power after Tereza's team captured him. The succubus girl, Lyric, who gave the evil power to Duardo, said she needs Tereza's help to defeat Duardo.

title: Defend the Village From Goblins
description: Survive against hordes of goblins in this casual survival rpg.

title: The Scorchfarer
description: A scarred kingdom, a mourning god and an unfulfilled promise made with the past. Uzu and Zuhaar, two continents ravaged by a cosmic event are the setting of The Scorchfarer. The story follows Mikaela and Yukiharu, a Terramagus team tasked with healing their world and unraveling its secrets.

title: Kamikaze Kommittee Ouka 2
description: A classic style turn-based RPG. After a spike in crime in the neighborhood of Danmura, "Kamikaze Ouka" is asked to deal with the problem. Seeing how bad the situation has gotten, she agrees to fight the roaming gangs and restore peace to the neighborhood.

title: Missing
description: "Missing" is a first-person horror adventure game set in 1970s Hong Kong. The story follows a young man named Jiahao, who is led by a mysterious force into a renovated historic district. A series of strange events unfold, and upon arriving, Jiahao feels a nausea and longs to escape.

title: Musicle
description: You can play whatever you want from Youtube or your computer! This game will be quite difficult. You can challenge other player's score.

title: Jail Simulator
description: Jail Simulator is the ultimate experience of being in jail, featuring good graphics, immersive first person animations, dialogues, fights and more!

title: Necronomistore: Before Black Friday
description: Before Necronomistore was the titan of an industry that became too big for its own boots, it was just a humble shanty shop with an empthisis on saving space and serving the worst living and undeadbeings in the local area.

title: Blackjack Professional
description: Enjoy the classic game of Blackjack with the new Blackjack Professional. Blackjack is a card game where you face off against the dealer. You're both trying to get to 21 points without going over. Whoever gets closest, wins. It's that simple.

title: Bingo Blitz
description:
Experience your online bingo game as you never have before, while going on a bingo games adventure, in Bingo Blitz.

Join Blitzy the cat for awesome online bingo games missions, online bingo freebies, goodies and more bingo fun besides!

What are you waiting for? Get playing Bingo Blitz now!

•Multiple card play: One bingo card is SO old-skool - play multiple free bingo games at the same time!
•Grab Powerups: Need a little extra? Grab powerups for even bigger bingo wins!
•Collect souvenirs: What’s a round the world trip if you don't have cool stuff to show for it? Grab souvenirs in every city you visit!
•Win special bingo cards: This is Bingo Blitz, free bingo with a difference - we do things a bit differently here.

•Go on fun free bingo quests all around the world for epic bingo live prizes and bonuses, including extra credits, coins and power-ups!
•Play free bingo games tournaments, with DAILY wins!

International online bingo is SO much more fun with friends; free bingo doesn't get much better than this!

title: They Speak From the Abyss
description:
Venture into the Abyss and face strange and horrifying monsters in this bone chilling RPG.

With the spirit Sophia at your side, you must venture into the nightmare-ish world of the Abyss in order to escape. Monsters will block your path, will you be strong enough to conquer them, or will you perish and join the other lost souls who roam the depths.

title: Aliens: Eradication
description: A GZDoom MOD using Kontra Kommando's Aliens: Trilogy/Ultimate Doom modification as its base. Play as four unique classes against the power of the Xenomorphs, all while battling with Weyland/Yutani Company forces, opportunistic mercenaries, and malfunctioning combat droids. Play with Doom or Doom 2 wads and pwads or try the included map set for the ultimate terror.

title: Paddleground
description: A First person paddle ball-er

title: Screaming Loaf
description:
Screaming Loaf is a wacky puzzle-platform game.

The fridge contents have one goal; to become a sandwich. They'll stop at nothing to fulfil their quest of smearing themselves on some bread, but these fillings have chosen the wrong loaf to mess with. Loaf happens to have a scream so powerful that it can shatter jam jars, melt butter, and explode cheese!

Each level has you control Loaf with the objective to destroy all enemies. The game is played using 5 buttons; move left, move right, scream, jump, and drop a slice. Different enemies have different strengths, so some may require multiple screams to eliminate. Screaming is not only good for damaging enemies, Loaf's scream can also push levers and propel himself across water. Loaf is made up of 5 slices, Loaf has the ability to leave slices behind and re-join with them later, any dropped slices will scream at the same time as the control slice. More points are scored for completing levels quickly, so dropping slices in next to where enemies are about to spawn is useful to defeat them more efficiently. Dropping slices plays a big part in puzzle solving too. Slices also act as health, a slice is lost from Loaf upon enemy collision. Beware though, each slice you drop gives Loaf one less slice of protection. You will fail the level when you lose your control slice.

Will you manage to save Loaf from becoming a sandwich?

title: Wonders of Aether
description: Wonders of Aether is a free-to-play anime-inspired open-world MMORPG by Japanese developer MEKASMITH.

title: Cursetorn
description: Cursetorn is a strategic horror game where the player acts as a doctor treating a patient inflicted with a seemingly incurable curse. The game revolves around you and your patient, Kein, as they slowly succumb to the effects of the curse and lose their humanity.

title: Berzerk Flashback
description: Anthology of Berzerk Studio's old flash game catalog. Includes 18 full games, updated to remove ads and microtransactions, plus some unreleased projects and prototypes.

title: Crimesight
description: In Crimesight investigators will work with an AI called “Sherlock” to prevent a future murder cooked up by another AI known as “Moriarty.” However, there is a traitor in their midst, secretly helping the Moriarty AI. Players will have to decide who they can trust as they try to deduce the truth.

title: Sophia the Traveler
description: Have you ever been to Venice of Italy? If not, then please don't miss "Sophia the Traveler"! Follow this lovely heroine as she roams around the City of Water, look for objects and characters scattered all over the stunning landscapes and embrace the local culture amidst the vivid city!

title: Sucker Punch VR
description:
Sucker Punch VR is pong at the next level. It is a single and multiplayer VR experience that is easy to learn and heart-pounding fun to master.

Punch cubes past your opponent while not letting any past you. Collect and use an arsenal of gloves allowing you to unleash a variety of power-ups.

Play single games to hone your skills, or join the leagues and battle your way to trophies and glory! Think you are the best? Grab a friend and find out in head-to-head multiplayer!

title: Shooty and the Catfish: Fully Reloaded
description:
Weird things are going on and it's up to our two hero Monster Hunters, Shooty and Zaat, to solve these unsolvable mysteries, only they aren't really heroes and they don't ever really solve anything...

Join them on a wild adventure inspired by some of the many games that were inspired by Earthbound.

title: Stratospiel
description: An indie RPG where a child awakens on a strange planet with their memories erased. As they travel the planet in search of the truth, they meet various characters and enemies that they can befriend or destroy in turn-based combat, with their choices affecting the tone and the story.

title: Sandwich Sudoku
description: In Sandwich Sudoku, the puzzle is presented with extra numbers outside the grid next to each row and column. These numbers indicate the SUM of cells sandwiched between the 1 and the 9 in that row/column. The logic required to solve the puzzles will appeal to anyone who enjoys normal sudoku and a bit of basic maths. Each puzzle here has been lovingly hand-crafted by Mark Goodliffe and Simon Anthony, the hosts of Cracking The Cryptic. They've even included their own hints on each puzzle to help if you get stuck. Mark and Simon have both represented the UK many times in the World Sudoku Championship.

title: Miracle Sudoku
description: Miracle Sudoku features beautiful puzzles that at first glance look impossible to solve!! Indeed, some of our Miracle puzzles have as few as two givens digits (!) but you will find them all to be solvable with a bit of clever logic! At launch you will be able to play through 4 variants all of which make use of a non-consecutive restraint (ie neighboring cells cannot have two consecutive numbers in them). They are Non-Consecutive Sudoku, classic Miracle Sudoku (non-consecutive + knight + king restrictions), Non-Consecutive Thermo Sudoku and Non-Consecutive Sandwich Sudoku. Each of these variants has a unique feel which refreshes the logic you may be used to, especially in thermo and sandwich sudoku!

title: Lysfangha
description: Embody the demi-goddess Imë and purify the temple where the Lysfangha is kept. Using your temporal powers, duplicate yourself by going back in time. Cooperate with your clones to repel the invasion!

title: Discover My Body
description:
In the year 2040, human beings look for increasingly strange solutions in hopes of finding connection and community.

This is a very short game.

title: Project ZM
description: Project ZM is a work-in-progress vanilla+ hack for the North American (U) Metroid Zero Mission ROM. It is designed to fix errors add new gameplay routes, tricks and mechanics.

title: Estress
description: Estress is an indie 3D platformer the mian atractive is that with each death the game become more and more difficult.

title: The Zodiac Trial
description: The Zodiac Trial has begun, and everybody's life is on the line! Will these 12 jurors be able to solve the mysteries and cooperate, or will they resort to betrayal, deception, and violence? Get out alive or die, die again!

title: Clarevoyance
description: Clarevoyance is an adventure game set in the mythic Acadian region of Clare, Nova Scotia, created directly with the community.

title: Security Breach: Fury's Rage
description: Security Breach: Fury's Rage is a side-scrolling fighter game. The game was published as an apology for the second delay of Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach.

title: Five Nights at Candy's Remastered
description:
No company is without a rival.

Freddy Fazbear's New Pizzeria has closed for good. And so, another restaurant is going to take its place in the world of entertainment.

What could go wrong?

title: LiveScream
description:
Armed with nothing but your curiosity, streaming equipment, and insatiable need to impress others, you approach a long-abandoned house in your small town.

What could possibly go wrong? LiveScream is a horror/comedy visual novel with point-and-click elements.

Step into the role of an intrepid ghost hunter-slash-live streamer-slash-average high schooler and explore a haunted house with your adoring audience.

title: Hakuchuumu no Aojashin
description:
All of humanity has come to share the same dreams.
Some nights, a tale of adultery between a teacher and his student.
Other nights, a romance between a commoner playwright and a noblewoman actress.
Yet other nights, a story of burgeoning love between a truant young man and a teacher-in-training.
Again and again people see these same three dreams.
Why does everyone now endlessly experience these dreams?
This is the story of the girl who's called the world.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's Plus
description:
Five Nights at Freddy's Plus, unofficially dubbed as FNAF Plus Restored is an indie point-and-click fangame developed by LostPawPlay, ripped direct from Phisnom's cancelled project Five Nights at Freddy's Plus. The final release of FNAF Plus Restored would release months after the official cancellation of Phisnom's Fazbear Fanverse project Five Nights at Freddy's Plus.

Later development on the game would be stopped due to controversy on the fan game and Five Nights at Freddy's creator, Scott Cawthon.

title: Saikoro Psycho
description:
The heroines are all psychopaths!

A visual novel ADV where you fall in love with crazy girls.

Be careful not to be killed by psychopathic heroines when you play!

title: The Dilma
description: The Dilma is a game that mixes horror with a little political humor. With the antagonist being the ex-president of the Federative Republic of Brazil, Dilma Rousseff.

title: Women of Xal
description: A political intrigue visual novel with romanceable elements. Player decisions weigh heavy as consequences can easily lead to hurt and trouble.

title: PuzzlePolygons
description: PuzzlePolygons is a top down puzzle game, designed to infuriate. The original score purposely created for the game is eerie and cryptic, and the game is challenging. Have fun trying to finish it! The game fits in with the reset theme, as the screen is constantly resetting/restarting.

title: Ocolast: Origens de Paulo Guina
description: Ocolast - Origens de Paulo Guina is a fan-made prequel to the parody horror game, Ocolast. as you control Jailson Mendes, a reporter trapped in a prison with a deranged inmate called Paulo Guina.

title: Sentou Yousei Yukikaze: Yousei no Mau Sora
description: Flight combat game based on popular novel and anime series. Players jump into the cockpit of futuristic jet planes and duke it out in the skies with the latest hi-tech weaponry. The main Mission mode tells a coherent story based on the anime and lets players progress through connected scenarios. There is also a Versus mode for split-screen two-player battles, and the Extra mode that duplicates the feel of traditional flight combat arcade games where players compete for the highest score. Supports Dolby Digital 5.1 surround sound and the Japanese Top Gun flight stick. Released only in Japan.

title: Realm of the Tempest
description: "Realm of the Tempest" is a new retro inspired fantasy adventure role-playing game from Bramble Gate Studios. The player controls temporal magic, and leads a team of familiar spirits to fight and explore a haunting dreamworld. Searching for resolutions leads to more mystery and doubt, as the player visits ancient kingdoms plagued by black magic.

title: Skullcaps
description: Skull Caps, the RTS video game sequel to Baldies, where the player takes command of creatures named skullies that are pitted against hairies. There are 45 levels. To proceed to the other level skullies have to destroy all hostile units and buildings.

title: Chase Ace 2
description: Fly your spaceship around on the level and shoot at everything that shoots at you. There are refueling zones where ailing ships can replenish their shields and weapons and safe zones that offer a respite from the action, but there's little time to think about anything other than your immediate survival.

title: Animal Paradise
description: A cartoony simulator management game where you run a zoo that includes mundane as well as fantastical creatures

title: Waterslide Island
description: Waterslide Island is a 3D game that lets you race cartoon animals down 10 dangerous, curvy water slides. You can knock other players off the slide, collect bubbles and bonus items to increase your score, and create your own courses with the included course editor.

title: Hateful Chris: Never Say Buy
description: Hateful Chris is a 2D side-scrolling adventure starring Chris, a skull-faced boy who hates consumerism and the mainstream culture. With an arsenal ranging from sticks to nuke launchers, Chris goes on a reckless violent killing spree.

title: Water In Fire 2
description: Water In Fire 2 is a nautical-themed game about shooting down airplanes. Play as a ship, an oil platform, or a plane, and shoot down the enemies that try to take you down.

title: EB Worlds
description: An educational game meant to teach the principles of game development. The tutorial levels present the players with games that are not working properly, and tasks them to change the behavior of the objects in them to proceed.

title: VulcanVerse
description: VulcanVerse is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) where players create their own adventures, interact with others and buy land to design their own buildings, products and services. Essentially, it’s a virtual world built by the players for the players.

title: Spark the Electric Jester 3
description:
Continuing directly from where Spark the Electric Jester 2 left off, Join Spark on his mission to overthrow his rival once again. Blaze through fast action packed stages and experience a new and improved combat system.

The gameplay is a mix of action and platforming in a clever way, taking elements from many games of both genres, you are able to find powers that change the way you play, enjoy great freedom of movement, discover many different ways to beat each stage, and ways to do it faster.

title: Touhou Endless Dream
description: A bullet hell roguelike game. Players can utilize characters with different abilities, collect and assemble powerful items. Dance through an unending barrage of bullets to save both yourself and Touhou Gensokyo from the darkness that is engulfing everything.

title: The Theater
description: The old creepypasta legend has been reborn! The spiral head man continues to haunt you throughout the theater. This time it's a point and click thriller which gives you quicker access to many parts of the theater finding clues to the reality that surrounds you. It's unpredictable what comes next in each walkthrough. It could be a strange paranormal haunting you or it could be nothing. As you dig deeper into the walkthroughs, you'll soon start to find out that its more than just a game...

title: Slendytubbies Ø
description: Slendytubbies 0 is a reimagining of the original 2012 game. It features story mode and new gameplay mechanics.

title: Darkin.Space
description:
An 2.5D multiplayer online space shooter inspired by the .io genre and games like Warpfire, Nova Raider, Andromeda 5 and DarkOrbit! Available for Browser, Windows, Mac OS and Linux! Visit darkin.space for direct access.

Join short session fights against other players in real-time, chase the best place in the ranking and collect in-game currency for customizing your ships with lots of different cosmetics or for getting new shiny ships with new specials!

title: Ragnarok X: Next Generation
description: Mobile MMORPG from the Ragnarok Online Franchise developed by Gravity Co.

title: TranscendPang
description: TranscendPang is a freeware doujin shoot 'em up created by wosderge. The game's gameplay is mostly derived from the classic arcade game Buster Bros., also known as Pang, but with some key differences. Where Buster Bros. may be described as an action game, TranscendPang takes the basic "Pang" format and turns it into a frantic shoot 'em up experience. The soundtrack features several artists from the Japanese doujin and rhythm game scenes.

title: Viking Trickshot
description:
A throwing physics challenge that's tricky to master, set in a bizarre Viking universe. Play kubb for laughs in ridiculous 2 player (shared device or online), or for gold and to unlock all achievements in 1 player, with more than 100 levels!

Based on the real Viking game of kubb, taken to the extreme. Encounter various worlds and play with various characters from Viking mythology.

title: Bro Falls: Ultimate Showdown
description: Bro Falls is an asymmetric massively multiplayer party game with chaotic elements, trap activations and big Falls. Up-to 60 online players in a showdown party and only one who can get the victory. Play as Brokkoli to activate the traps or avoid them as a juicy food and win the rounds.

title: Hexagon Knockout
description: Hexagon Knockout is a multiplayer bumper car game where the objective is to knock out your opponents. You control a vehicle capable of firing rockets using its cannon at the rear. Play all the different game modes, offline as well as online.

title: Farming Simulator 22: Day One Edition
description:
Prepare for new crops, new maps, new machines, new brands and more. Oh, and it’s getting snowy, too: The addition of seasonal cycles is also included - as well as other features to be announced soon!
